description: Why someone would want to create this deadly and massive polearm dropped by Absolix the Uncreated from the Lore of AdventureQuest is truly a mystery…

name: Accursed Spear of Madness
description: Deep below the waves, down in the depths where no light shines, your Master waits. Your role: to serve the ancient, eldritch god who steals hearts and souls of heroes, binding them to its will. (This item is color customizable)

name: Acid Rain Spear
description: Using their magic to pollute and cause harm to Lore, these acidic magi gain their powers from dirty sludge and other toxins.

name: Activated Devourer of Souls Greatscythe (0 AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Activated Devourer of Souls Greatscythe (AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Ada's Light Scythe
description: Ada's scythe has been imbued with the essence of Goodness. It shines with the light of her honor and loyalty.

name: Ada's Overcharged Scythe
description: This scythe belongs to the top Seraphic Assassin so you better make sure nothing happens to it.

name: Ada's Scythe
description: This scythe belong to the top Seraphic Assassin so you better make sure nothing happens to it.

name: Aegis of Destiny (0 AC)
description: A blade for those who do not question their purpose or the path ahead. Destiny is not a promise, it is a command.

name: Aegis of Destiny (AC)
description: A blade for those who do not question their purpose or the path ahead. Destiny is not a promise, it is a command.

name: After Dark Feather Fan
description: See, people rocking, hear people chanting, feeling hot, hot, hot!!

name: Air Fènnù de Hóuzi Glaive
description: Feel the rush of the wind when you grip this polearm.

name: Air Fènnù de Hóuzi Ornate Glaive
description: Feel the rush of the wind when you grip this polearm.

name: Akh-a's Spear
description: The spear emits a soft Celestial glow, reminding Akh-a of what they once had. Why did the Bright One make them shine, only to take it all away?

name: Akriloth's Bane
description: The flames rise. The dragons call. Akriloth, Fire Dragon King has been taken… As you wield this polearm in battle, whispers of Akriloth fill the air around you.

name: Albedo Light Spear (0 AC)
description: A spear once made of pure Darkness was purified into white gold. The Evil within was silenced, and it is destined for a hero's hands. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Albedo Light Spear (AC)
description: A spear once made of pure Darkness was purified into white gold. The Evil within was silenced, and it is destined for a hero's hands. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: All-Seeing Spear of Chaos
description: You can feel the chaos emanating from this polearm. Do not stare into its eyes or you'll risk madness! This weapon gives a 10% bonus to Chaos. (This item goes rare on July 31st)

name: Alpha Werejaguar Polearm
description: Only those Werejaguars who attain Alpha Status are worthy of wielding this massive trophy!

name: Amaranthine Tri-Spear
description: When this polearm was forged with void magic, both ice and darkness became compatible with the other. These elements are unexpected combindations, but the pain they inflict on their targets togather is eternal.

name: Amethyst Poleaxe
description: It may look too sparkly and pretty too take info battle, but this gem will knock you across the room!

name: Amethyst Scythe
description: Made by Bido, this amethyst scythe is filled with the fiery flames of one of the most unusual volcanoes in Lore - and only Bido knows where it is!

name: Anaerobic Trident
description: Once belonging to a Rotting Naval Commander, this trident was salvaged from the depths of The Natatorium.

name: Anamnesis of Khione (0 AC)
description: The Queen of the Ice Dragons who lived before Cryozen's birth once ruled the Northlands. When she was shattered, her crystal bones calcified. Some of her ice remains, unable to be manipulated by today's Cryomancers.

name: Anamnesis of Khione (AC)
description: The Queen of the Ice Dragons who lived before Cryozen's birth once ruled the Northlands. When she was shattered, her crystal bones calcified. Some of her ice remains, unable to be manipulated by today's Cryomancers.

name: Ancient Knight's Polearm (AC)
description: Long before the Guardian Tower rose in the heart of Battleon, an order of knights roamed the land, dedicated to helping those in need. Now you, too, can fight as they did.

name: Ancient Knight's Polearm (Legend)
description: Long before the Guardian Tower rose in the heart of Battleon, an order of knights roamed the land, dedicated to helping those in need. Now you, too, can fight as they did.

name: Ancient Nightmare's Spear (0 AC)
description: Deep in the shadows, the Queen's creatures stalk the realm. Waiting for the unwary to come closer… closer… before they strike.

name: Ancient Nightmare's Spear (AC)
description: Deep in the shadows, the Queen's creatures stalk the realm. Waiting for the unwary to come closer… closer… before they strike.

name: Anti-Kolyaban Trident
description: For those who do not wish to follow Kolyaban and her twisted ways.

name: Antiquated Shadow Swordstaff
description: ShadowSlayers have battled the creatures of darkness for as long as we can remember… and always will.

name: Anubian Overseer Spear
description: The Anubians who remained loyal to Neith once kept the skies from falling, and the rivers from drying. Now, they fight to spread death, and satiate an age-long grudge.

name: Anubian Skyfall Spear
description: The Anubians who protected the Deified Pharaoh of Storms helped him keep the sky from falling on the Sandsea. Even as he rests in his tomb, Djeba's Anubians keep the sky aloft with their spears.

name: Apatheia Reaper
description: In an act of reconciliation, Lord Dage retrieved the souls of Legionnaires who fell because he betrayed their expectations. The forgiven rebels are forged into weapons, awaiting the day when they'll be ready to regain their bodies.

name: Apatheia Scythe
description: In an act of reconciliation, Lord Dage retrieved the souls of Legionnaires who fell because he betrayed their expectations. The forgiven rebels are forged into weapons, awaiting the day when they'll be ready to regain their bodies.

name: Apocalyptic Darkblood Spear
description: The Darkblood are not only shunned, but derided for a lack of finesse. They're seen as animals that carry unwieldy sticks and stones. The spear mercifully puts those rumors to instant rest.

name: Apocalyptic LichKing's Scythe
description: With an army of undead, you can destroy the world… all you need to do is create it!

name: Apocryphal Destroyer's Chainsaw
description: Dark forces are hungry to feed on any hero unfortunate to wield this blade. Will you risk great power and great rewards… if the cost is your life itself?!

name: Aqua Rage Trident
description: Neptune himself would be impressed with this mighty trident.

name: Aqua Rage Trident +25
description: Neptune himself would be impressed with this mighty trident. Gives +25% more damage to undead when equipped!

name: Aqua Vivae's Edge
description: Deep below the waves lives a nation of sea dragons. Masters of aquatic elemental magic, these ancient and powerful creatures have never been known to interact with the humans of Lore… until now. (This item is color-customizable to base, trim, and accessory.)

name: Aquamer Trident
description: With so many ships traveling in and out of Lolosia there's always a need for new First Mates… I wonder what keeps happening to the old ones?

name: Aracara's Limb
description: Definitely a spider's arm. Eww… it's still twitching!

name: Arc Aura Lance
description: A regal lance that could part the seas, deserts, and tundras in one thrust. It belonged to a peerless King, falling from his grasp when he became obsessed with the power of Monsters and the Forbidden. No one has touched this lance since.

name: Arcane Dark Caster Scythe
description: Your work is grim, but all too necessary. For every soul you take, your power grows tenfold.

name: Arcane Evolution Spear
description: A spear crafted by one of the original founding Mages, meant for the hands of a Warrior companion. These days, Mages have a wider array of skills, and can choose to adventure solo.

name: Arch DoomKnight Polearm
description: The Arch Doomknights were once a duo of corrupt dragonslayers who traded their lives to become death knights in their quest for power and fame.

name: Arch Lich's Spear
description: Light does not always equal right. One of the most powerful magic-wielders in the Celestial Realm, the Arch Lich controls entire legions of undead reanimated with the power of Light.

name: Archer's Lance
description: An emperor's lance destined for you.

name: ArchFiend Judge's Scythe (0 AC)
description: The ArchFiend's Commandant is entrusted to review, vet, and test those whom Nulgath is considering for further advancement. It is a position very rarely granted.

name: ArchFiend Judge's Scythe (AC)
description: The ArchFiend's Commandant is entrusted to review, vet, and test those whom Nulgath is considering for further advancement. It is a position very rarely granted.

name: ArchFiend Overlord's Spear (AC)
description: Seated at the right-hand of Nulgath the ArchFiend, his Overlord oversees the hordes of Nation followers as they race to conquer all the corners of Lores and the Oversoul for their Master.

name: ArchFiend Overlord's Spear (Special)
description: Seated at the right-hand of Nulgath the ArchFiend, his Overlord oversees the hordes of Nation followers as they race to conquer all the corners of Lores and the Oversoul for their Master.

name: ArchFiend Spear
description: Nulgath lets out a mighty guffaw. "Hero, this spear is a very special one, it changes to its' owners will allowing them to make it take any color they desire. However..the soul that resides in this weapon is a powerful one, don't listen to it..or it will consume you!"

name: Archfiend Titan's War Glaive (AC)
description: Archfiend Titans serve as tanks in battle, drawing fire from the mages and paladins sent to attack Nulgath's forces.

name: ArchFiend Titan's War Glaive (Non-AC)
description: Archfiend Titans serve as tanks in battle, drawing fire from the mages and paladins sent to attack Nulgath's forces.

name: Archfiendish Spear of Death
description: (Item does 40% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)Crafted from the bones of a certain dracolich from the Tercessuinotlim, Oblivion crafted this for you under Nulgath's orders.

name: Arena Rockstar 8th Scythe
description: Slay your opponents (and all those music pirates), with the 8th scythe and be a true rockstar to your favorite band!

name: Ascendant Scythe
description: Ascendants are Atealan mages who can bend the power of the cosmos to their will, gaining powers from the six zodiac signs of the Atealans to channel in battle.

name: Ascended Paladin Spear
description: Only those with a true heart of good may lay their hands on this holy spear.

name: Ascent to Arms
description: "Ah, I have been stabbed by this beautiful poker."

name: Aspar
description: Intricate and beautiful, this polearm will serve you well in battle. Don't let its fragile appearance fool you. It is deadlier than imaginable. This weapon was forged by Unleashed Rage.

name: Astaroth's Reaver Polearm
description: Legend tells an DragonLord so powerful, Nulgath personally made him the first Void of that kind. His power knew no bounds so be wary of this items.

name: Astral Quasar Spear
description: The harmony of the cosmos is a choir of twinkling stars and roaring storms. Quasar Spears, pulled from the flesh of Cosmic Dragons, are each thought to contain the power of those calamities and miracles. (CC to Trim, Accessory)

name: Astravian Alchemist's Polearm
description: The armarents of Astravia, meant to purge vamin putsiders from the lands of Alprecha's Beloved. When the outsiders were eradicated, what was left for these blades? All that remained was the blood of Astravia's Citizens.

name: Astravian General Lance
description: High ranking Astravian warriors are required to be experts in all forms of combat and weaponry. Titania and Regulus preferred the up close and personal. Captain Aurola's marksmanship was peerless. Together, their only weakness was the affection they held for their fellow Astravians.

name: Astravian General Pike
description: High ranking Astravian warriors are required to be experts in all forms of combat and weaponry. Titania and Regulus preferred the up close and personal. Captain Aurola's marksmanship was peerless. Together, their only weakness was the affection they held for their fellow Astravians.

name: Astravian Royal Spear
description: A marvelous spear for Astravia's finest.

name: Astravian Saw Scythe
description: A common tool used by the mercenaries of Astravia.

name: Astravian Serrated Scythe
description: A common tool used by the mercenaries of Astravia.

name: Atrocious Harvester
description: A diabolically effective scythe designed to help you cut through swathes of shadow-souled enemies with almost inhuman ease.

name: Attached
description: More like a surgical implement then a scythe. Cold, efficient, and brutal.

name: Aulorian Spear
description: Let the golden reflections show you the way!

name: Aurelian Spear
description: Unleash the power of the lion.

name: Aurora Summoner's Polearm (0 AC)
description: Celebrate the return of the light / bands of color in the night / And ribbons of red, green and gold shining bright!

name: Aurora Summoner's Polearm (AC)
description: Celebrate the return of the light / bands of color in the night / And ribbons of red, green and gold shining bright!

name: Aurous Blessing
description: I'm not the one to tarnish a solid gold scythe in battle, but let the rich do what the rich want.

name: Auspicious Spetum (0 AC)
description: These ShadowSlayer's toil in defense of the Crown. Stationed in Darkovia, they hold the line against the Vampires and Weres.

name: Auspicious Spetum (AC)
description: These ShadowSlayer's toil in defense of the Crown. Stationed in Darkovia, they hold the line against the Vampires and Weres.

name: Autumn Magic Harvest Scythe
description: This gorgeous scythe has been crafted from fallen leaves, campfire smoke, and RAWRGobble feathers.

name: Avarice of the Legion's Scythe
description: Avarice is a trait that many in the Legion possess. They crave loot, gold, and glory.

name: Avatar Of Death's Scythe
description: Grasping such a live-saver can give you temporary immunity to mortal causes of death at one cost; hold it too close to you and your life flashes before your eyes. Is relieving your most painful moments in the life you lived worth the risk of this scythe?

name: Avomancer Spear
description: When you want some dark meat but the plate is across the table.

name: Awakened Death's Requiem Scythe (0 AC)
description: A rare soulforged weapon that honor the dead. Inhabiting this scythe are souls who relinquished their right to a peaceful afterlife. They empower the wielder with their strength, and destroy those that would defy death.

name: Awakened Fiend Naginata
description: A blade in the shape of a sharp grin, reawakening in the age of a new Archfiend. It was born from Darkness, twisted by the unfathomable nature of the Fiend God's Void.

name: Awakened Fiend Poleaxe (0 AC)
description: The axe sneers, pulsing power ciphoned from the trapped Fiend God themselves. Some whisper that the Archfiend will one day take on its fearsome form when he ascends.

name: Awakened Fiend Poleaxe (AC)
description: The axe sneers, pulsing power ciphoned from the trapped Fiend God themselves. Some whisper that the Archfiend will one day take on its fearsome form when he ascends.

name: Awakened Fiend's Spear
description: The spear growls, pulsing power siphoned from the trapped Fiend God themselves. Some whisper that the Archfiend will one day take on its fearsome form when he ascends.

name: Awakened Scythe of Gazeroth
description: Power and magic… Djinn Knights must possess both if they are to successfully guard the denizens of the Djinn Realm.

name: Awakening Frost Shatter Spear
description: The one weapon that can break a frozen prison and release those trapped in a timeless void. Some where in the southern pole's snow, a single Frost Shatter Spear waits, plunged into a crowded glacier.

name: Axe of Everlore
description: One day, the sun will shine everlasting. This sacred dream won't come true on it's own. Cleave the Darkness, destroy all Evil, let the Light into your heart, and allow it to save Lore.

name: Bakuscythe
description: Made by Tomcat to help you fight off your bad dreams… or catch them to keep.

name: Banana Guandao (AC)
description: Slip into Summer with this beachin' banana polearm. It's got real a-PEEL.

name: Banana Guandao (Non-AC)
description: Slip into Summer with this beachin' banana polearm. It's got real a-PEEL.

name: Basalt Claw
description: Dropped by ones of the nefarious Sky Pirates, this scythe will chop down any foe to size!

name: Battle Cleric's Draconic Spear
description: The Priests of the Dragon suspect dragon's blood may run in the veins of Swordhaven's royal family, if only a thin stream. Battle Clerics have sworn to guard both the priests of their order and members of the royal family until death… and beyond.

name: Battle Mage's Staff
description: For a battle mage to be able to protect Lore and the Amberheart Tower, they first must wield a staff powerful enough to cast their spells. This staff is color custom.

name: Battleon DragonSlayer Spear of Poking
description: An updated version of the DragonSlayer spear. All the better to stab dragons with!

name: Battlepoint Scythe
description: Steer your allies towards the weakest foes with this razorsharp polearm!

name: BattleStaff of the Ravenlord
description: The accoutrements of the Ravenlords cannot be wielded by mere mortals… all who try crumble to dust at the first touch.

name: Batty PitchFork
description: Send any villains a pointed message when you battle them with THIS baby!

name: Batwing Scythe
description: Forged from pure Silver, this hand held scythe features the distinct wings of the Vampire Bat. Warning: not intended for recreational baseball.

name: Beast of Pirate's Bay Trident
description: You smell something? It's your trident. (not the gum)

name: Beast of Vokun Polearm
description: Let the beast inside go with this.

name: Beastbane's Blood Spear
description: In the hands of a battlemage, the spear can fly for miles when thrown. It won't stop until it finds the heart of its mark. (Item gives 25% more EXP when equipped.)

name: Beastmaster of Nulgath Spear
description: Nulgath's creature aren't small, you will need something long and terrifying to keep them in line with.

name: Bedraggled Cherrywood Cane
description: Duke Chauncy P. Winterbottom III used this cane while taking evening promenades through his rose garden. Then he got zombified, so now he just uses it to bludgeon people and eat their brains.

name: Berserker Polearm
description: A traditional stone-cut polearm that gave the Darkblood an edge against heavily-armed rivals for centuries until it was lost in history. Nowadays, after much effort from a curious hero, it has found its way back.

name: Beyond Death and Time
description: The Shinigami is never seen without their reaper.

name: Bido's Toxic Flame Spear
description: Bido - legendary artist, tester, and all-around great hero - celebrated his birthday by crafting this new blade for you!

name: Bioluminescent Trident
description: ﻿﻿﻿When individual Drow cross paths in the deep sea, they duel. The winner earns the right to take the defeated's coral horns, and fasten them to their trident. Coral horns only glow when they are fed the magic of the duel's winner.

name: BitterEdge Blades
description: Double the coldness, double the fun!

name: BitterEdge Slicer Polearm
description: It's a wonder that this weapon breaks bones, rather than the snowflake perched upon it.

name: Bitterfrost Doublebladed Polearm
description: Tales of your deeds are chilling… and so is your cold, cold heart!

name: Black Dragon Ronin Naginata (0 AC)
description: The Ronin, free from the contract with the Nation, carries parting gifts with them. This Naginata grants anyone who wields it mastery over the spear, allowing you to peel through armor and scales.

name: Black Dragon Ronin Naginata (AC)
description: The Ronin, free from the contract with the Nation, carries parting gifts with them. This Naginata grants anyone who wields it mastery over the spear, allowing you to peel through armor and scales.

name: Blackfire Halberd
description: Balanced for both reach and ruin, this polearm was forged beneath the shadow of Idalion's wings as the flames roared.

name: BlackSkulls Polearm
description: When Friday the 13th day loses its light, the BlackSkulls come to play in the night.

name: BlackSkulls Scythe
description: When Friday the 13th day loses its light, the BlackSkulls come to play in the night.

name: Blacksteel Dragon Spear
description: The obsidian metal used for this bow is coated in a super-heated dragonbane coating, specially prepare to /slay ANY of Lore's dread dragons.

name: Blade of Corruption
description: A deadly weapon for knights strike from a distance.

name: Blade of the Dead
description: This cruel weapon steals the souls of it's victims. Only the destruction of this blade could ever hope to free the trapped spirits.

name: Blade of the Shadow Born
description: This bladed staff will bring the fall of every man, creature, and living thing.

name: Bladed Polearm of Betrayal
description: Once a noble weapon, it has now been stained with treason, deception and dishonesty. It will never be clean again.

name: Bladed Polearm of Havoc
description: CHAAAAAAAAAAAAAOOOOOOOOOOOOOOS!

name: BladeMaster's Fauchard
description: The blademaster's weapons are carved with precision to move through the air faster than the human eye can see.

name: Blades of Order Pike
description: Given out to the Blades of Order's infantry, this pike range has no match when it comes to dealing damage from long distances.

name: Blades of Order Spear
description: To protect the Amberheart Tower, the Blades of Order must wield a weapon long enough to reach their foes.

name: Blazerun Beacon Staff
description: If your foes were employees they'd be fired.

name: Blazing Antares Scythe
description: The heat of this scythe can incinerate your enemies long before it touches them. It burns with the heat of a star that achieved the might of a sun.

name: Blazing Serpentis Imperator Spear
description: A pale gold serpent entwined with gold. A lost soul yearning for warmth. This spear is wielded by a divine royal who was cast into the dark, unwanted yet dutiful.

name: Blazing Solar Staff
description: This staff is powered by an alternative energy source: the sun! It will be WAY too hot for your opponents to handle!

name: Blessed Bident
description: Blessed by an ancient saint, the Blessed Bident has resurfaced only for the most glorious day of the year. Whoever wields the Bident will be graced with the same honor for the remainder of time.

name: Blessed Raziel
description: This superior weapon of bright sunlike sorcery is actually Raziel, Sayn's Celestial Knight partner, taking her battle form.

name: BlightSlayer Polearm
description: Winter has come and thankfully you're dressed for it. The Blight King and his army won't stand a chance.

name: Blinding Scythe of Destiny
description: As Death cowers in the corner, you proceed to walk amongst the living, sending the wretched into the dark depths below!

name: Blinding ZombieSlayer Spear
description: Spear of the Zombie Killers, defenders of the living and destroyers of the undead!

name: Blood Amber Spear
description: Petrified blood, easily mistaken for ruby crystals, adorns this vile spear. It's tainted with poison, and breaks into fragments that get stuck in the victim's wounds. Even if they escape alive, they'll melt into a red puddle within the night.

name: Blood Flame Dragon Polearm
description: Depending how its user perceives the eternal flame locked within this heat-sensitive weapon, it can either represent destructive rage or the need to grow for the better. Take your pick and be ready to travel that path.

name: Blood Scythe Of Destruction
description: Embrace the shadows but beware… the light of the celestial realm can harm you!

name: Blood Sworn Polearm
description: These warriors serve a powerful master, they've sworn an oath only to him. The price? Their own blood.

name: Bloodborne Plague Scythe
description: Plague Knights use the infectious powers of this scythe to increase the decay rate of their victims brains if things are going to plan.

name: Blooded Key Polearm
description: Capable of producing frost upon touch, the very blades must be the reason why the grass is so icy before winter. No wonder the Legion favors these.

name: Bloodmoon Faerie's Scythe

name: Darkon's Debris 2 Replica

description: One swing, one cut, and your soul ensnared in a web of curses forever. Even death can not rescue you from your writhing fate.

name: Deorum Lance

name: Desert Star Spear
description: The tip of the spear is rumored to be a shard of a fallen star. It glows with the power of a fervent wish made by a Sandsea Princess from generations past. What that wish was is lost to time, but her will became undying.

name: Dessert Spear
description: The best part of the Harvest Feast is the dessert course!

name: Devious Pitchfork of Ruin
description: A devious weapon made manifest from the evil intentions in your heart. Like lying about doing your chores, shoplifting, and sticking gum under chairs. Truly, you're the scum of the earth.

name: Devious Scythe of Ruin
description: A devious weapon made manifest from the evil intentions in your heart. Like lying about doing your chores, shoplifting, and sticking gum under chairs. Truly, you're the scum of the earth.

name: Devoured Stone Lance
description: Where the stone breaks, vines and blooms grow to fill the cracks. This lance is made of stone that has been crush and scorched by war, yet it refuses to lose its identity.

name: Devoured Stone Poleaxe
description: Where the stone breaks, vines and blooms grow to fill the cracks. It may take centuries or even eons, but everything returns to earth. Even steel. Through elemental magic, the axe has been returned to stone, becoming a brutal primal weapon.

name: Devourer of Souls Greatscythe (0 AC)
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

description: Hold this bloodthirsty scythe as if you have eyes on the back of your head to effectively cleave your foes. Gives 25% more exp when equipped.

name: Diabolical Burial Spade
description: Typically given to travelling to travelling monks from the high court, this spade is used to give defiled corpses proper rest. Being forged from refined silver, the shovel is also made to bury bandits and ambushers.

name: Diabolical Monk's Devastator
description: An ornate poleaxe, crafted for the most brutal of cultists, gifted to those who prove they wish to push their body to its physical limitations.

name: Diabolical War Gonfalon
description: A weapon to be raised high, flying a banner of devotion. This pike shows your relentless dedication to ridding the world of beasts.

name: Digital Destruction Lance
description: You will shatter an empire and bring their king to his knees… if something made up solely of little squares can kneel down.

name: Dimensional Trick Scythe
description: A flashy weapon that demands attention. If you and your enemies lose track of it for even a second, it'll start moving on its own. No one will be safe.

name: Dirge and Rhapsody
description: Replicas of a voice that knew joy and sorry, death and delight. They faded into mystery with the King of the Dark's demise, but art brought them back to life. The whispers of ancient ghosts guided the brush, and reached perfection.

name: Disperazione
description: Ice Elf royalty wielded this scythe like a regal sceptre. Birds of prey were a favored symbol, representing hierarchy of the Northlands. The ice may freeze you, but this blade will decide when you'll be allowed the mercy of death.

name: Divine Retribution
description: An honor to wield and an honor to die by, the Divine Retribution rightfully sacrifices the morally unjust and has been blessed by a Seer of absolute Good.

name: Divine Storm Scythe
description: The Thundersnow Demigod reaps, but never sows. Their scythe swings for wrath and pleasure, for they believe that taking life, taking the world, taking everything is their divine right.

name: Doom Creeper Leg
description: Break a leg and use it for battle! A leg once belonging to a Cardaverous Creeper.

name: Doom Shiden Bardiche
description: As deadly as it is precious (stone), The Shiden is named for the unique crystal at the top of the pole—literally meaning "purple lightning"

name: Doom Spear
description: Who is this stranger? They only appear near Father's Day… I wonder if Sepulchure has anything to do with this.

name: Doom Star Polearm
description: A special type of starsword given to agile Star Captains and Upholders, it is something specialy made to keep thieves and unseen enemies from ambushing you. If they are spun in a 360 degree angle, it can also make a decent shield. Don't try this at home or anything near flammable.

name: Doom Star Scythe
description: Use this scythe with care because mental strength is needed to properly control its power.

name: Doom Worshipper's Scythe
description: Sepulchure's hold is strong. These warriors follow the shadows and support their Lord.

name: Doomed Fate Reaper
description: This scythe reaps the Light, but has found new purpose culling the weak from the Shadows. Why should you serve a Master? Servitude breeds feebleness. Your power will cut unworthly Shadow down.

name: DOOMFire Spear
description: This mighty spear's power to start a raging whirlwind of harvested souls and thickened dark clouds allows it to live up to the legendary DoomKnight's name.

name: DOOMing Fork
description: A useful polearm that is used for tuning instruments, slaying monsters, and skewering large chunks of Gorillaphant meat. Move aside, spork!

name: DoomWood Dragon's Cry (0 AC)

description: The DoomWood DragonKnight's original Dragon couldn't be recovered in one piece. The Necromancers used what they could find to craft a new spear for their Warrior. It roars, luring Dragons into the dangerous night.

name: Double-bladed Gladius Pole
description: *No description* Demolish your enemies inside the arena and beyond with style and grace. The last thing they'll see is your golden gauntlet before you SMASH IN THEIR FACE!

name: Double Bladed Soul Scythe
description: Reaps double the amount of souls.

name: Double-Edged Paragon Spear
description: When the minions harvest souls for Dage, not all are used. The Paragon fiends feed on the some of the discarded to gain more strength and power.

name: Double-Headed Abominator Poleaxe
description: Double the slaugther double the fun!

name: Double Saber of Ebil
description: Fear is the path to darkness. With this you will feel the power of darkness.

name: DoubleBlast Staff
description: Slice your opponents from a distance with glowing nanotech!

name: Doublesided Painblade
description: Double the Blade, double the battling! Long un-live the Shadowscythe! Long live the Alliance! Save the Empress!

name: Draco Tenebris Scythe
description: A grisly reminder that death looms for everyone.

name: Dracolich Destroyer Scythe
description: If you want to slay dragons then use the bones of a dragon.

name: Dracolich Guandao of Death
description: Weapons of this make are feared by Empires that rely on the Sun. This Guandao survived the flames that desperately tried to eradicate the Shadows, and waits to bring death to Lore.

name: Draconian Poleaxe
description: This terrifying weapon is as beautiful as it is deadly.

name: Draconic Rhongomyniad
description: Not many dragons exist in the Underworld but a few must be wrangled by the most fierce dragon warriors in the Legion.

name: Draconic Tigress Polearm
description: Combine the raw power of a dragon and a tiger, no one will stand a chance.

name: Dracotaclysm
description: The bones of the dragon whose bones comprise this scythe are burned out from a charred volcanic eruption, but if a pyromancer is in possession of it, these bones will light up once again.

name: Dragon of Time Reaper
description: The Eternal Dragon of Time is one of the most powerful beings Lore has ever seen. Torn by war, corrupted by Chaos, and reborn anew to walk Lore once more - wield the power wisely.

name: Dragon of Time WingBlade
description: The Eternal Dragon of Time is one of the most powerful beings Lore has ever seen. Torn by war, corrupted by Chaos, and reborn anew to walk Lore once more - wield the power wisely.

name: Dragon Pike of Pain
description: Just where the offense begins and ends is a mystery. There isn't a spot on this pike that can't cause brutal damage and pain. No matter what your enemy tries, you have an answer.

name: Dragon Reaper Scythe
description: The Dracolich Lord wants their former compatriats to suffer. Their Dragon wishes for more brethen. This scythe swings, and grants them both their desires, cruely separating Dragonlords from their partner forever.

name: Dragon's Dark End

name: Dragon's Demented End
description: If the DragonPlane Guardians revere their Draconic kin so much, why do they carry tainted Dragonslayer weapons? In truth, they idolize the unstoppable force of nature that is death over anything else.

name: Dragon's Plague Scythe
description: Plague Knights use the infectious powers of this scythe to increase the decay rate of their victims brains if things are going to plan.

name: Dragon's Reach
description: Nothing and no one will be out of your reach with this vicious blade. Watch your enemies quiver as the dragon stares down the blade into their very soul before consuming it.

name: Dragon Tongue Scythe
description: An ancient scythe created in the image of a legendary dragon not from this plane of existence. Even Death recognizes the scythe's otherworldly properties.

name: DragonFang Staff
description: Bring the pain with this noble staff forged with 100 dragon fangs! Only true DragonClaw Guards are worthy of wielding the DragonFang Staff.

name: DragonFire Spear
description: Forged by the flames of the great red dragon Akriloth, the platinum DragonFire Spear is as much a symbol of greatness & honor as it is a great & powerful polearm. Color customizable to your base color, too!

name: Dragonknight of Nulgath Spear
description: With metal made from treasure stolen from the Red Dragon's Lair, this spear was forged for the most elite of Nulgath's Dragonknights!

name: DragonSlayer General Spear
description: A super classy update to the DragonSlayer spear.. only for Generals!

name: Dragonslayers Dread
description: The blood red blade pulses when Dragonslayers are around.

name: Dragonsworn Champion Spear
description: Drawn from the energy of the skies, electrify your foes with the power of Krenos.

name: DragonTamer's Poleaxe
description: Dark and mysterious, the Ruby DragonTamers are most at home in the dark fire lands where the slyest of dragons make their homes.

name: Drakka Defender Polearm
description: Now that you've defeated Zorbak's Dracolich's you're rewarded with this stone polearm. Hopefully he doesn't get anymore ideas…

name: Dread Knight's Scythe
description: Dage the Evil sends his Dark Knights forth to terrorize the good and lure the wicked to his realm. The most skilled may prove strong enough to join the Undead Legion.

name: Dread Knight Spear
description: A weapon doesn't get a reputation of being spontaneous and bloodthirsty unless its owner works for it.

name: Dread Rider Lance
description: Every mounted warrior needs a lance to poke, prod and stab people with.

name: Dreadhaven Halberd
description: It's pointy and sharp, get the jobs done.

name: Dreadhaven Halberd +5
description: It's pointy and sharp, gets the job done.

name: Dreadhaven Spear
description: Keep foes at bay with this.

name: Dreadhaven Spear +5
description: Keep foes at bay with this.

name: Dreadnought's Polearm
description: The polearm of the Paragon Dreadnought. Use it at your own risk.

name: Dreambound Unicorn Scythe
description: Unicorns can sense pure souls, and have deeply protective instincts towards them. Death will come to those who wish to taint their dreams.

name: Drowned Trident
description: These monks gain their power from water. I'll bet they live near the coast!

name: Druid's Legacy
description: The Greenguard Druids were able to harness the power of nature to control the elements around them. They've granted you a weapon to do the same.

name: Druidic Ice Scythe
description: Life feasts on death, even in the dark nights of the North. No wheat or fruit can grow here, which means the druids call upon the ice to reap flesh.

name: Dry Ice Polearm
description: You will be the coolest hero on the battlefield with this frigid ice-cold polearm.

name: Dry Ice Polearm +10
description: You will be the coolest hero on the battlefield with this frigid ice-cold polearm. This polearm grants a 10% bonus to rep rewards!

name: Dual-Bladed Tiger's Fang (AC)
description: Your swings are on par with this other famous tiger I know.

name: Dual-Bladed Tiger's Fang (Special)
description: Your swings are on par with this other famous Tiger I know.

name: Dual-Edged Betrayal Pole
description: Once a noble weapon, it has now been stained with treason, deception and dishonesty. It will never be clean again. Dual version.

name: Dual-Edged Duneskewer
description: Slice 'em, dice 'em, and skewer all who attack you! The Dual-Edged Duneskewer will make mincemeat of your enemies!

name: Duality Doubleblade
description: The Duality Sorcerer reaches through Time to gather power from both Good and Chaos in order to power their spells.

name: Duel Molten Greatswords On A Stick
description: Okay, this is getting a little ridiculous.

name: Earth Fènnù de Hóuzi Glaive
description: Feel the power of the terra when you grip this polearm.

name: Earth Fènnù de Hóuzi Ornate Glaive
description: Feel the power of the terra when you grip this polearm.

name: EarthVessel Harpoon
description: A harpoon blessed by Nature, meant to be used to hunt aberrations that crawled out of the sea. The Rulers of the past noted that pirates achieved this arduous task, and awarded them noble titles.

name: EbilCorp Fishman Trident
description: After a decade of service, the Fishmen recieve the honor of having their names inscribed on their trident. Note that the trident must be returned upon resignation or termination.

name: EbilCorp Plague Spear
description: No one's going to quietly quit with the threat of being skewered looming over them.

name: Ebony VoidCaster Rift Staff (0 AC)
description: The VoidCaster's first task is to open a rift and pull their staff from the void. It may appear inanimate, but nothing from the void is as it seems.

name: Ebony VoidCaster Rift Staff (AC)
description: The VoidCaster's first task is to open a rift and pull their staff from the void. It may appear inanimate, but nothing from the void is as it seems.

name: EC Mach 6 Spear
description: You look like a drone, you act like a drone… but only to get to the front of the line!

name: Ecto Poleaxe Of Insanity
description: Insanity is contagious.

name: Ectoplasmic Pole
description: The ecto-steel from which this blade was crafted on can be found in the spirit realm.

name: Edge of the Archfiend
description: Crafted by fiendish weaponsmiths chained to infernal forges, this polearm was crafted in honor of Nulgath the ArchFiend. Only the strongest members of his Nation are worthy of wielding it.

name: EggHunter Berserker's Polearm
description: What came first - the bunny or the egg? Did these EggHunters become berserkers because of the egg hunt? Or does the egg hunt call out to berserkers? Who knows…

name: Eggstreme Hunter-Berserker's Polearm
description: What came first - the bunny or the egg? Did these EggHunters become berserkers because of the egg hunt? Or does the egg hunt call out to berserkers? Who knows…

name: Electric Arc
description: This scythe will attract more than just attention! It'll revolt your enemies with it's shocking electrical currents!

name: Electric Pool Noodle
description: You'd think that combining lightning and water would be dangerous. Not for the Thunderborn!

name: Elegant Siren's Trident (AC)
description: NO ONE can resist the lure of this siren's call… and when you fall, you'll embrace your fate with open arms.

name: Elegant Siren's Trident (Non-AC)
description: NO ONE can resist the lure of this siren's call… and when you fall, you'll embrace your fate with open arms.

name: Elegant Vampire Scythe
description: Followers of The Unseeing, these Vampires love to hang around and listen to Alice in Chains.

name: Elemental DragonSlayer Polearm
description: The goldsmith that created this sword and shield was known to be a savant artist on the battlefield and from the comfort of his forge, therefore, he merged beauty and brute strength inti one masterpiece.

name: Elemental Kyrios Naginata
description: A weapon that acts like a wand for the Kyrios. Its origins are in the far off country, where the Avatars are venerated only if their magic can serve their aims of conquest. The blade was a gift to a Kyrios that aided in the toppling of a castle.

name: Elite Dragonspear
description: Use this weapon to give yourself an advantage when you encounter fire breathing dragons. Strike them before they can critically strike you!

name: Elite Fortress Guard Lance (AC)
description: Rarely used for combat, these canes are usually held face down for scare. As elegant as they seem, rumor has it that they are actually keys used to open a portal to a post-apocalyptic dimension. Knowing that this one is in your possession, would you like to find out?

name: Elite Fortress Guard Lance (Legend)
description: Rarely used for combat, these canes are usually held face down for scare. As elegant as they seem, rumor has it that they are actually keys used to open a portal to a post-apocalyptic dimension. Knowing that this one is in your possession, would you like to find out?

name: Elite Guard's Scythe
description: Like most Drakel weapons, this scythe runs on currents and energy.

name: EmberFlame Pike
description: The EmberFlame Dragonkin have willingly given themselves up to serve dragons who have allied with Malgor and his ShadowFlame army.

name: Embodied Spear (0 AC)
description: A spear that embodies death, or rather it's a spear that's a dead body. It isn't overjoyed to be reduced to an item, but weapons can't protest.

name: Embodied Spear (AC)
description: A spear that embodies death, or rather it's a spear that's a dead body. It isn't overjoyed to be reduced to an item, but weapons can't protest.

name: Emerald Edge of Gorgok
description: If you thought diamond was the hardest element, you'll be sadly mistaken. This enchanted emerald can cut through even the hardest opponent!

name: Emerald Poleaxe
description: It may look too sparkly and pretty too take in battle, but this gem will knock you across the room!

name: Empire's Origin Scythe
description: A growth of unknown origin was found in the corner of the Flying Fortress' prison cell. When the meat was cut away, the bony handle of a scythe was found. It hisses static, and screams to be noticed.

name: Empowered Double Bladed Soul Scythe
description: The scythe hums with the power of a witch's soul.

name: Empowered Shadow Spear
description: This item does 51% more damage to all monsters when equipped. A spear forged from the shadows of the underworld.

name: Empyrean Scythe
description: An experimental weapon made created at the peak of the Gilead technology. Its unique design allows for a perfect flow and channeling of pure magic energies.

name: Enchanted Abaddon's Terror
description: The Dreadspiders and Souleaters are frightful foes and the weapons they employ are also quite nasty. They are crafted with cruel powers. This poleaxe is home to two deadly crawlers of the underworld. Anyone touching this weapon besides it owner will fall victim to the lethal bites of its residents.

name: Enchanted Caster Scythe (0 AC)
description: With a slice, slice here and a slice, slice there…

name: Enchanted Caster Scythe (AC)
description: With a slice, slice here and a slice, slice there…

name: Enchanted Chronomancer's Trident
description: The source of your magic flows in rivers between worlds, between timestreams. Tapping it requires a power very few mortals possess. (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Enchanted Default Spear
description: The metal blade of this spear has been enchanted. You can customize its color any time you want!

name: Enchanted Doomed Fate Reaper
description: This scythe reaps the Light, but has found new purpose culling the weak from the Shadows. Why should you serve a Master? Servitude breeds feebleness. Your power will cut unworthy Shadow down. (CC to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Dracolich Guandao of Death
description: Weapons of this make are feared by Empires that rely on the Sun. This Guandao survived the flames that desperately tried to eradicate the Shadows, and waits to bring death to Lore. (Item is fully color-customizable.)

name: Enchanted DragonMage's Spear
description: Something wicked is definitely on its way when Enchanted DragonMage's meet to summon powerful dragons. Their rituals are magic in the making.

name: Enchanted Edge of the Risen
description: You really blew it in that last night.

name: Enchanted Fiendish Monkey Staff
description: Through deranged sorcery, the Fiendish Monkey King turned another member of Nulgath's Nation into their personal staff. Every inch of their body hates that ape, but they can't do anything about it. (This item is fully color customizable.)

name: Enchanted Final Hope Halberd
description: Malgor is is the personification of his creator's hope. When he was set free, it sealed their fate. He made this halberd to remind him of the one person he could never save. To honor them, Malgor must be perfect in every way.

name: Enchanted Folião Furioso Staff
description: The primal fear of darkness makes your heart beat harder than any drum. This Carnaval belongs to the shadows!

name: Enchanted Greataxe of Dread
description: After merging an ordinary weapon looted from Lord Reignolds' lair with a mysterious, enchanted gem, this weapon pulses with a strange and unsettling power.

name: Enchanted High Axe of Dread
description: After merging an ordinary weapon looted from Lord Reignolds' lair with a mysterious, enchanted gem, this weapon pulses with a strange and unsettling power.

name: Enchanted Infernal Underworld Poleaxe
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction. (Item is CC to Eye)

name: Enchanted Infernal Underworld Trident
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction. (Item is CC to Eye)

name: Enchanted Kisshoten Naginata
description: A spear that delivered an era of prosperity to the Yokai Isles when it was used to extinguish the life of an evil Dragon. Legends say that a new era of happiness will be delivered when it tastes the blood of a Dragon once more.

name: Enchanted Lance of Doom Reborn
description: This lance rose from the shade of the eclipse. It calls for a new partner with a desire for vengeance as dark as its own. Chained to your hands, it becomes an extension of your will…or rather, "our" will. (CC to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Marine Dragon Spear (0 AC)
description: When Marine Dragons fight, they tear off each other's fins, and retreat to regrow them. The fallen spines can be crafted into spears that can rip through the water like it's air.

name: Enchanted Marine Dragon Spear (AC)
description: When Marine Dragons fight, they tear off each other's fins, and retreat to regrow them. The fallen spines can be crafted into spears that can rip through the water like it's air.

name: Enchanted Martial Rokushakubo (0 AC)
description: A simple staff with weighted ends, meant to enhance your martial arts. An experienced fighter sees this as an extra limb. (Item is color-customizable)

name: Enchanted Martial Rokushakubo (AC)
description: A simple staff with weighted ends, meant to enhance your martial arts. An experienced fighter sees this as an extra limb. (Item is color-customizable)

name: Enchanted Nation Ritualist Spear (0 AC)
description: A weapon of battle, and a tool for the ceremonies of ritualists. They carve the flesh of ancient beasts, and use their life blood to engrave runes on stone. (Item is color customizable)

name: Enchanted Nation Ritualist Spear (AC)
description: A weapon of battle, and a tool for the ceremonies of ritualists. They carve the flesh of ancient beasts, and use their life blood to engrave runes on stone.

name: Enchanted Poleaxe of Dread
description: After merging an ordinary weapon looted from Lord Reignolds' lair with a mysterious, enchanted gem, this weapon pulses with a strange and unsettling power.

name: Enchanted Prisma Spear
description: Use the force to mesmerize your enemies with this color-shifting spear crafted of polarized paladinum.

name: Enchanted Sandstorm Sceptre
description: A sceptor that calls upon the power of the storm. Though Pharaoh Djeba used it to protect his people, it has the destructive capability of summoning winds that can strip skin from bone.

name: Enchanted Shadow Battle Spear
description: Those who study the magics of the ShadowFlame slowly begin to become one with them.

name: Enchanted ShadowFlame Great Harp
description: A harp wielded by bards dedicated to sing the praises of Vulvan, Great Spirit of the Ring of Fires… this instrument has been enchanted and is now color-customizable.

name: Enchanted ShadowFlame Scythe
description: Continual study provides these Warlocks with the ability to fully control their flames.

name: Enchanted ShadowMancer's Great Scythe
description: The head of the staff resembles that of your loyal crows. Their songs are of death, rot, and opportunity. (This item is color customizable to Trim.)

name: Enchanted ShadowMancer's Scythe
description: The head of the staff resembles that of your loyal crows. Their songs are of death, rot, and opportunity. (This item is color customizable to Trim.)

name: Enchanted Skullpiercer Trident
description: Like a vengeful god of the sees, Naval Commander Vordred wields his trident with great impunity. He'd rip skull after skull from their bodies, and have to wade through the water to retrieve his weapon whenever he threw it.

name: Enchanted Spear of Doom Reborn
description: This lance rose from the shade of the eclipse. It calls for a new partner with a desire for vengeance as dark as its own. Chained to your hands, it becomes an extension of your will…or rather, "our" will. (CC to Accessory)

name: Enchanted Spectral Spear
description: When pointed at any other member of your pack, the spear sharpens. It pierces bones as easily as grave soil.

name: Enchanted Terror of Enyo (0 AC)
description: A lance that sunders civilization, bringing eras to their end. Though it's coveted by the Horsemen of the Undead Apocalypse, Dage The Evil intends to give it to a divine god of the end.

name: Enchanted Terror of Enyo (AC)
description: A lance that sunders civilization, bringing eras to their end. Though it's coveted by the Horsemen of the Undead Apocalypse, Dage The Evil intends to give it to a divine god of the end.

name: Enchanted Vanguard Reaver Of Nulgath
description: Marching proudly at the forefront of Nulgath's Nation, the warriors in his Vanguard are the first to terrify his opponents and recruit soldiers to his army. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Enchanted Volleyballer's Foam Spear
description: Life's a beach, no matter which position you play on your team! Bump… Set… SPIKE!

name: End of the Gods Scythe
description: What cannot be bound or conquered must be destroyed.

name: End Render
description: Stab 'em, skewer 'em, poke 'em til they run. The skull on the hilt let's them know you mean business… and that your business is being mean!

name: Energy Reaper Scythe
description: A recreation of an epic energy scythe sold at Light's Sabers NG Shop in the Lore of MechQuest's timeline.

name: Energy Scalpel
description: You don't need a M.D. to effectively wield this Energy Scalpel!

name: Energy Slicers
description: Slice your opponents from a distance with glowing nanotech!

name: Enhanced BroomBroom
description: Why use a magic carpet when you have an… ENHANCED BROOM!

name: Enlightened Aurichalcum Trident
description: An elegant trident one can find washed up on the beach, or stuck between the corals. The people of the surface touch it without a second thought. Slowly, their minds open. They're willed to turn to the sea, becoming adherents of the depths.

name: Envenomed Spear of Nulgath
description: Weapons made by the Archfiend grow with their monstrous wielder. Spines, pincers, and teeth will keep sprouting until it's impossible to tell what's beneath the horror.

name: Epiphany of Phantasiai
description: The Lord of the Underworld forged gifts for the Oraculi, engraved with one of the lessons he learned sitting in on a debate. The scholars pursued knowledge for its own sake, attaining a constant state of contentment even in death.

name: Epoch Definer Pilum
description: A spear forged from the birthstone of an era-defining hero. It was meant to protect the flow of time from interdimensional threats, until its wielder stared too long into the void of time and space.

name: Equilibrium's Edge Scythe
description: So…pretty.

name: Era Definer Pilum
description: A spear forged from the birthstone of an era-defining hero. It was meant to protect the flow of time from interdimensional threats, until its wielder stared too long into the void of time and space. (This item is color-customizable.)

name: Escherion's End
description: Escherion may have croaked, but in the end I think he got the point.

name: Escherion's End +3
description: Escherion may have croaked, but in the end I think he got the point. (Gives 3% more damage against Chaos AND 3% more Class Points.)

name: Eternal BeastMaster's Glaive
description: Using the powers of Shadow and Chaos, these BeastMasters use all their skills in support of Malgor.(Color Customizable)

name: Eternal Dragon's Anchor (0 AC)
description: YARRR! The Eternal Dragon of Time commands a crew that sails across space and time, pillaging throughout the past and present, fighting through the future, and looting both land and sea.

name: Eternal Dragon's Anchor (AC)
description: YARRR! The Eternal Dragon of Time commands a crew that sails across space and time, pillaging throughout the past and present, fighting through the future, and looting both land and sea.

name: Eternal Dragon's Spear (0 AC)
description: The power of the Eternal Dragon of Time flows through your whole being.

name: Eternal Dragon's Spear (AC)
description: The power of the Eternal Dragon of Time flows through your whole being.

name: Eternal Duality Staff
description: The fight between Good and Evil is never more apparent than when it takes over your entire being. Which way do you lean?

name: Eternal Juggernaut Spear
description: Like the Warriors of the Shadowflame army vow to follow Malgor, the Eternal Juggernauts await the ultimate victory… and their rewards. Their control over the galaxies contained in their weapon is shown by the ability to change their colors.

name: Eternal Piercer Bladed Staff
description: The time dragon thanks you for your valiant efforts defending its life!

name: Eternal Sovereign Guard's Spear
description: In depictions of the Sovereign, what looks to be a crown or a halo adorns their neck. The spears of the Guards wear the same crown, a symbol of the Eternal's divinity.

name: Ethereal Scythe
description: The crystalline sound you hear comes from chimes inside the scythe's blade.

name: Evil Lance Of Prevarication (AC)
description: *No description*

name: Evil Lance Of Prevarication (Merge)
description: *No description*

name: Evilnator
description: That dark energy is actually even sharper than the blade.

name: Evisceration Reaper
description: As an unholy follower, you already know of the pain and suffering that can come from the jagged blade of this scythe.

name: Evolved Bunny Berserker Spear
description: Eggs to high to reach? Going BERSERK? This spear will give you those few extra inches to nab your Grenwog delectables! Find the Magical Marshmallow Cheep, the Gold-Foil Chocolate Bunny, and the Basketful of Dyed Eggs dropping off of the bosses in Greenguard Forest and use them in Cabdury's merge shop.

name: Evolved Legion Vampire Scythe +5
description: Legion Vampires are unlike any other. Brutal, remorseless, and cruel, Vampires brandish this monumental scythe as a fair warning to anyone foolish enough to cross their path. Gives 5% more XP when equipped.

name: Evolved Necromancer's Scythe
description: When one ascends beyond the mere raising of bones, then one can be called Evolved.

name: Evolved Ogre's Spear
description: The spear used by the Coliseum's Champion Bestiarius, The Ogre!

name: Evolved Shadow Spear of Nulgath
description: A blissful power-hungry treasure newly-transformed vampire earn after they partake in a massive bloodbath, which most are highly reluctant to do. Such actions are impending signs that this vampire may end up a villain.

name: Evolved Warlord Spear
description: A dreadful ex-spear-ience for anyone to behold.

name: Exodus Guardian's Scythe
description: This scythe was crafted and forced from an Exodus Titan's flesh. This is an image of a beast biting down on Shadows, using it as a means to deal death. It was meant for the hands of a certain Dragonlord from another time, but has found a worthy master in you.

name: Eye of the Underworld Scythe
description: Two things not to ask Dage about this scythe, 1) what's that eye looking at? 2) who's eye is it?

name: Facet of Hyonix
description: A crystal spear bearing the Great Dragon of Water's name. The craftsmanship is exceptional, but where did it come from? It's crystal tip can conjure pools, but they're not filled with water. You can hear its laments…

name: Fairy Queen's Scythe
description: Certain Fae courts are cutthroat, for Fae are ageless and capricious beings. A Queen can only be replaced if they're killed. Usually, its their sires or knights who suddenly get the playful urge to wear a pretty crown.

name: Fall ScareCrow's Scythe
description: The best way to sneak up on your enemy is to blend in with your environment. During Harvest, what better camouflage than as a scarecrow?

name: Fallen Darkblood Spear
description: A Hollowborn weapon afforded to the Fallen Darkbloods Vici called forth from shadows. They're replicas of the spears originallyused to fell the Darkdweller in his first life. Their symbolic weight isn't lost on the dead Darkbloods.

name: Fallen Dread Scythe
description: All that glitters is NOT gold. Having this beauty definitely adds to your bling stats.

name: Fallen King's Scythe
description: You either die a hero, or live long enough to see yourself succumb to the chaos.

name: Fallen King's Scythe +3
description: You either die a hero, or live long enough to see yourself succumb to the chaos. Or.. Both, in Alteon's case. (Gives 3% more damage against Chaos AND 3% more Class Points.)

name: Fallen Leviathan's Festering Tusk
description: This spear's point was scavenged from the body of an ancient beast infected by a voice and tainted thoughts. It fed and fed on a festering evil. As that evil disappears into the belly of the sea, it gives rise to new malicious intent.

name: Fallen Leviathan's Spear
description: This spear's point was scavenged from the body of an ancient beast infected by a voice and tainted thoughts. It fed and fed on a festering evil. As that evil disappears into the belly of the Sea, it gives rise to new malicious intent.

name: Fallen Scythe of Vengeance
description: So…pretty.

name: Fallen Wanderer Spear (AC)
description: Can break through even the strongest ice.

name: Fallen Wanderer Spear (Special)
description: Can break through even the strongest ice.

name: FallFire Scythe
description: Mother nature has bestowed upon you her branches so that you can defeat the land!

name: FallFire Staff
description: Mother nature has bestowed upon you her branches so that you can defeat the land!

name: Fang of the Archfiend
description: Be happy you got a weapon, sometimes Nulgath followers only get a stick.

name: Favored of Kyanos Polearm
description: The Envoys of Kyanos have very special gear to help handle the cold as they battle through the icy lands of Glacera.

name: Fear of Light (1)
description: Toil on the battlefield and dispense trouble everywhere you go! Note: Bubbles, bubbles not included.

name: Fear of Light (2)
description: The absence of light is darkness so you will not fear the darkness with this. You took this from the Willowcreek War Chest after battling for Chaos in World War Lore!

name: Fear of Shadows
description: Who knows what chaos lurks in the heart of Heroes? This staff knows. You took this from the Willowcreek War Chest after battling for Chaos in World War Lore!

name: Fènnù de Hóuzi Fire Glaive
description: Feel the power of fire when you grip this polearm.

name: Fènnù de Hóuzi Fire Glaive Ornate
description: Feel the power of fire when you grip this polearm.

name: Ferocious Flame Scythe
description: Forged in the heat of the Champion of Fire's fury, these blades will sear the souls of all who oppose you.

name: Festa da Ferocious
description: Parade down the streets of the Sambódromo while wielding this festively ferocious polearm. Try not to hit any dancers!

name: Festive Pine Gift Scythe
description: Give the gift of a swift death to your foes.

name: Festive Punk Elf's Scythe
description: It's a punk rock Frostval, and the Frostval trees are decorated with safety pins.

name: Festive Scythe
description: A fun party outfit in which to celebrate the Bright Lights Festival! (Color Custom)

name: Fiend Champion's Spear
description: The Fiend Champion contains a small amount of Adimonde's power, given via the Fiend Shard. As they grow in power, so does Adimonde.

name: Fiend Mauler's Spear
description: You may think I am evil. I am not. I am the MOST EVIL.

name: Fiend's Abyss Spear (0 AC)
description: What is undead can never die… not when Nulgath can still make use of your skills and abilities!

name: Fiend's Abyss Spear (AC)
description: What is undead can never die… not when Nulgath can still make use of your skills and abilities!

name: Fiend's SoulRender (0 AC)
description: What is undead can never die… not when Nulgath can still make use of your skills and abilities!

name: Fiend's SoulRender (AC)
description: What is undead can never die… not when Nulgath can still make use of your skills and abilities!

name: Fiend's Spear of Oblivion (AC)
description: Another weapon forged from the armor of defeated Doomknights. The armors devoured their wearer's soul, and the Archfiend devoured Doom, fashioning the red metal into a weapon for the Nation.

name: Fiend's Spear of Oblivion (Legend)
description: Another weapon forged from the armor of defeated Doomknights. The armors devoured their wearer's soul, and the Archfiend devoured Doom, fashioning the red metal into a weapon for the Nation.

name: Fiend Void's Desire
description: A spear that was forged from steel mutated by radiation from the Fiend's Void. It influences 'food' to jump towards its tip, feeding it their blood.

name: Fiendfang Scythe
description: Crafted from the fang of a fallen fiend, even in death this warrior continues to serve Nulgath's Nation.

name: Fiendish Dragonbone Scythe
description: A Dragon's grudge gives the scythe an extra edge. It craves the downfall of others of its kind so that it won't have to suffer the humiliation of being an undead thrall alone.

name: Fiendish Frenzy of Ascension
description: The Nation's newest Fiends are being killed before they can finish mutating in the Fiend's Void. Blades from the abyss pierce their bodies. These practical jokes played by Adimonde were taken and reforged into masterpieces.

name: Fiendish Impaler
description: This spear is used by hunting creatures known to feed on magical energy.

name: Fiendish Monkey King Staff (AC)
description: Through deranged sorcery, the Fiendish Monkey King turned another member of Nulgath's Nation into their personal staff. Every inch of their body hates that ape, but they can't do anything about it.

name: Fiendish Monkey King Staff (Legend)
description: Through deranged sorcery, the Fiendish Monkey King turned another member of Nulgath's Nation into their personal staff. Every inch of their body hates that ape, but they can't do anything about it.

name: Fiendish Soul Reaper (0 AC)
description: A scythe that has become an extension of the wielder. The heavy blade sates the hunger of Fiendish Devourers, and prevents them from cannibalizing other Fiends.

name: Fiendish Soul Reaper (AC)
description: A scythe that has become an extension of the wielder. The heavy blade sates the hunger of Fiendish Devourers, and prevents them from cannibalizing other Fiends.

name: Fiendish Stormbringer Scythe (0 AC)
description: Fiends that have been turned into the Nation's Stormbringers grow metallic appendages that conduct and attract energy. These bits can be torn off to serve as weapons.

name: Fiendish Stormbringer Scythe (AC)
description: Fiends that have been turned into the Nation's Stormbringers grow metallic appendages that conduct and attract energy. These bits can be torn off to serve as weapons.

name: Fiendish Stormbringer Spear
description: Fiends that have been turned into the Nation's Stormbringers grow metallic appendages that conduct and attract energy. These bits can be torn off to serve as weapons.

name: Fiendish Transcendence Scythe
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: Fiery Fissure Scythe
description: A scythe that only those worthy of Kalayo's respect may wield. The two blazing scythes mirror the dragon's multiple heads. This weapon may one day grow a third head, as Kalayo did when they came of age.

name: Fight of the Light
description: Fight for honor! Fight for glory! And fight to defend all that is holy and light!

name: Final Hope Halberd
description: Malgor is is the personification of his creator's hope. When he was set free, it sealed their fate. He made this halberd to remind him of the one person he could never save. To honor them, Malgor must be perfect in every way.

name: Fire Claw Scythe
description: Infused with the fury of Xan himself, this weapon burns brightly with hateful fire.

name: Fire Monkey Staff
description: What do you have? A pointy stick.

name: Firebird's Fury Poleaxe
description: This axe, forged in the likeness of a great firebird, blazes with the heat of the rising sun. Only the worthy can wield the axe without it burning the skin off of their palms.

name: Firebird's Fury Spear
description: A glorious spear that, if used for evil and tyranny, will burst into flames. Your enemies will burn as you turn to ash with them.

name: Firefeather Spear
description: Made of bone, feathers and flame, Zoshi crafted this weapon while YOU watched and offered suggestions!

name: FireLord's Flame Scythe
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon a Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: FireLord's Polearm
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon a Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: Fishman Trident
description: The Fishman soldiers are known to fight with these weapons.

name: Flag of Poland (Polearm)
description: Za wolnosc Wasza i nasza! Fight for freedom and for honor. Your name will forever live in glory.

name: Flame Dragon Polearm (1)
description: Bestowed to those great warriors who have purchased Founder in AQ Dragons.

name: Flame Dragon Polearm (2)
description: The courage of the Flame dragon allows you to face to toughest monsters on Lore. Maybe with this, nothing will stop you! (But I doubt it).

name: Flame Guardian's Lance
description: The passion of these Guardians is clear from their fiery colors burning bright on the weapons!

name: Flaming Golden Deathspear
description: Give your enemies a good tip about fighting.

name: Flaming Moose Scythe
description: They may be cute, but moose can be deadly! Just like this katana scythe.

name: Folião Furioso Staff
description: The primal fear of darkness makes your heart beat harder than any drum. This Carnaval belongs to the shadows!

name: Forbidden EarthVessel Harpoon
description: A weapon once blessed by Nature has been cursed by forbidden magic. King Dethrix's forces used it to spear and capture human beings, dragging them off to the depths of the dungeons for who knows what.

name: Forbidden Ouro Scythe
description: Ouroboros ate a piece of Apophis' flesh during one of their many squabbles. He coughed the piece up, and it had transformed into a deadly scythe. Its mysterious eye stared back at them, desiring to flay the old and carve the new.

name: Forbidden Pathos Scythe (0 AC)
description: A truly wretched scythe made from the wings and limbs of a Fiend that 'had not yet hatched.' It will only allow its Nightfall brethren to wield it.

name: Forbidden Pathos Scythe (AC)
description: A truly wretched scythe made from the wings and limbs of a Fiend that 'had not yet hatched.' It will only allow its Nightfall brethren to wield it.

name: Fork of Ruin (Mem)
description: The single most powerful and dangerous known to all giant-kind.

name: Forked Trident (Mem)
description: This is the most awesome giant pickle trident EVER!

name: Formal Battle Cane (AC)
description: Congratulations Dage and Faith! The Lord of the Underworld and the Beast Mastahhh have started the next quest of their journey. Join the celebration!

name: Formal Battle Cane (Merge)
description: Congratulations Dage and Faith! The Lord of the Underworld and the Beast Mastahhh have started the next quest of their journey. Join the celebration!

name: Formal Skull Cane
description: For those who want a hint of macabra to their attire.

name: Forsaken Wraith's Scythe
description: This wraith wanders through the shadows of the Underworld, perpetually seeking those who abandoned them in their hour of need.

name: Fourth Consular Dual Axe
description: When words fail, drastic action must be taken. If you're going to have to take this path, you might as well pull out the biggest weapons you have.

name: Fourth Guardian Dual Axe
description: Guardians who wield the Fourth master a variety of weapons, but it just feels better to run at the Sixth with axes.

name: FrankenFiend Scythe
description: Dr. Voltabolt says: "You zurvived my latest creation, ze Frankenwerepire! Youl CRUZHED him! I zuppose I muzt go back to ze drawrink board."

name: Frigid Flame Spear
description: You might need a biggest fridge for this one.

name: Frigid Frostbarb
description: *No description*

name: Frigid Scythe of Vengeance
description: So…pretty.

name: Frigid Wolf Scythe
description: The fangs of the North's beasts pierce flesh and freeze blood. When their teeth were fastened into this blade, the steel grew cold and the frigid winds blew.

name: Frigid Wolf Spear
description: The fangs of the North's beasts pierce flesh and freeze blood. When their teeth were fastened into this blade, the steel grew cold and the frigid winds blew.

name: Frost Dracolich Guard's Spear
description: Keep warm this holiday season in an extra warm armor - also good for protecting various body parts when dealing with dracoliches.

name: Frost Scythe
description: It's Frostscythe's weapon!

name: Frost Shatter Spear
description: The one weapon that can break a frozen prison and release those trapped in a timeless void. Some where in the southern pole's snow, a single Frost Shatter Spear waits, plunged into a crowded glacier.

name: Frost Vampire Spear
description: Stay cool as you seek out your next victim.

name: Frostborne Scythe of Skade
description: A Dragon Prince turned himself into a Dracolich. Through Ice Necromancy, his corpse became a living monument to an extinguished bloodline. His mind and soul were lost to the ravages of time, turning him into a fierce force of nature.

name: Frostguard's Green Lance
description: The lance of the Frostguard - defend Frostvale from Dage the Evil!

name: Frostguard's Lance
description: The lance of the Frostguard - defend Frostvale from Dage the Evil

name: Frostguard's Red Lance
description: The lance of the Frostguard - defend Frostvale from Dage the Evil!

name: Frostkissed Bataille (0 AC)
description: A delicate halberd hand-carved from ice. Though you can use it in an actual battle, the creation was meant to be a toy, or a prop for a play. Granted, it wouldn't last long in a giftbox either. At least the edge is easily replaceable.

description: The Winter Raiders use this style of weapon in fighting off the great white wyrms of the northlands.

name: Frostlorn Scythe
description: The icy rift has spilled not only monsters into Lore, but also LOOT! Happy Frostval!

name: FrostScythe of Nulgath
description: Time to welcome your foes to the cold grips of death!

name: FrostScythe's Cruelty
description: It seems FrostScythe has had another scythe constructed for himself. Well now it's yours!

name: Frostsworn Ice Scythe
description: The icy wind isn't for the faint hearted. To reign in this frozen forsaken tundra you must have nerves of steel.

name: Frostval Barbarian Poleaxe
description: During Frostval these nomadic wanderers from the north travel from town to town giving gifts and protecting those in need. You don't want to be on their naughty list though, else be on the receiving end of their most infamous gift - their pure rage.

name: Frostvale Envoy's Pike
description: Deck the halls and then your foes!

name: Frozen Arabesque Spear (0 AC)
description: A spear that carved the ice of the deepest caverns of the North. The cold seeped into the steel, and will seep into your foes.

name: Frozen Arabesque Spear (AC)
description: A spear that carved the ice of the deepest caverns of the North. The cold seeped into the steel, and will seep into your foes.

name: Frozen Fire Spear

name: Frozen Force of Fury
description: The enchanted ice built onto this armor helps keep the cold of the Northlands at bay.

name: Frozen Lich's Spear
description: Imbued with power stripped from lost souls, this spear can pierce a hero to the core, then drain his life force in an instant.

name: Frozenflame Lantern
description: This scythe will light your path in the dark, but it won't keep you warm.

name: FrozenSoul Court Scythe (0 AC)
description: Nature is cold, wet, hard and unforgiving. As are these courtiers.

name: FrozenSoul Court Scythe (AC)
description: Nature is cold, wet, hard and unforgiving. As are these courtiers.

name: FrozenSoul Elf's Scythe
description: Deep in the Frozen Wastes of the Oversoul, Nulgath's Elves roam free, dedicated to serving their Master. He taught them how to forge this Hammer, so they could more efficiently cut down enemies in his name.

name: Furious Naginata
description: The use of a Naginata is characterized by its sweeping movements of both power and grace.

name: Fury Fiend's Polearm (0 AC)
description: These fiends are fueled by the fires of Nulgath's fury at any who would oppose him.

description: The only acceptable length from which to pet a tiger

name: Galactic Chronomancer's Trident
description: The source of your magic flows in rivers between worlds, between timestreams. Tapping it requires a power very few mortals possess.

name: Galactic Light Spear
description: Use the…schwartz! Wait, wrong movie.

name: Galactic Spear of Light
description: May the 4th be with you!

name: Galactic Star Polearm
description: A special type of starsword given to agile Star Captains and Upholders, it is something specialy made to keep thieves and unseen enemies from ambushing you. If they are spun in a 360 degree angle, it can also make a decent shield. Don't try this at home or anything near flammable.

name: Galactic Star Scythe
description: Use this scythe with care because mental strength is needed to properly control its power.

name: Galánta Tuar Ceatha
description: The lucky rainbow above shines your way, many victorious battles bring joy to your work and play! Happy Lucky Day!

name: Gall's Poleaxe
description: If an enemy is on the brink of defeat, it would be time to give them the axe and make room for victory.

name: Gears of Melancholy
description: This is not only a piece of art, but a deadly weapon to boot! Beware of the fighter who holds this weapon. Not only will it spread pain, dead and destruction, but for those who survive - dark melancholy.

name: Geki Halberd
description: Doubles as a weapon and farming tool, the Geki is an excellent addition for expert melee combat and meal time.

name: Gigante Core Spear (0 AC)
description: To make the giants of the Nation come to heel, the Beast Masters strike them with weapons akin to shock prods. This spear was forged from pure abyssal energy. There's even a chance it could wound Nulgath.
