name: Gilded Bonebreaker
description: All that glitters is not bone!

name: Gilded Dread Scythe
description: All that glitters may be gold and having this beauty definitely adds to your bling stats.

name: Gilded Frostedge Polearm
description: Crafted with only the highest quality Dwarfhold gems, this weapon is about as beauty as it is deadly. It belonged to a warrior of the Dwarfhold Aegis, before it disappeared into the Northlands.

name: Gilded Knight Spear
description: The spear leaves a gold streak in the shields, walls, and bodies pierced by it. People will know that you passed by.

name: Gilded Lobthulhu Scythe
description: Those lobster claws can pinch… especially when they're THIS big!

name: Gilded Ram Poleaxe
description: Good for ramming your way into places

name: GL-1ST Pronged Spear
description: Easily mistaken for an oversized tuning fork. Tap them against something metal and you will one hundred percent get electrocuted.

name: GL-24K Pronged Spear
description: Easily mistaken for an oversized tuning fork. Tap it against something metal and you will one hundred percent get electrocuted.

name: Glacial Destroyer Pike
description: To rise against injustice, you must be willing to send more than just shivers down your enemies' spines.

name: Glacial FrostScythe Scythe
description: Even the worst ice and snow is no match for these warriors!

name: Glacial Slicer
description: A scythe whose blade has been carved from the precious and rare amethyne stone.

name: Gladiatorial Trophy Spear
description: This sword is too much to handle.

name: Glaive Of Gourds
description: The spikes on such an unusual sword came from the multiple tusks of an orc warlord who did not share his thanks for the Harvest.

name: Glorified Spear of the Celestine
description: A spitfire and elegant spear decorated with rubies, causing it to be a spitting image of the sun's solar flares.

name: Glorious Spear of Stolen Treasure
description: A pirate's entire fortune melted, molded, and bejeweled. Its diamond edge only gets sharper with every ship you plunder.

name: Glowing Harvester Spear
description: Hired by the Furbles, these mercenaries follow them from world to world over what the Furbles leave behind.

name: Goddess of War Spear
description: The title of War is a coveted position, for battle is venerated by Lore and all those who march across its lands. This spear plunged into the heart of an ailing god who became unworthy of the title. The goddess rose in their place.

name: Gold Exalted Paladin Poleaxe
description: Had Trolle'din had the improved version of this armor, it is doubtful that he would have perished. Then again, this IS Trolle'din we are talking about. He probably would have fallen for the same trick.

name: Gold Exalted Paladin Spear
description: Had Trolle'din had the improved version of this armor, it is doubtful that he would have perished. Then again, this IS Trolle'din we are talking about. He probably would have fallen for the same trick.

name: Gold Infinity Pike
description: The hour of your victory is upon us! 2016 is the year you shall ascend to mastery!

name: Gold Pony Star Lance
description: It doesn't just destroy evil with a single pierce. It destroys their pride too.

name: Golden Ashray Trident
description: ﻿Land dweller goldsmithing was what gave Ashray weapons their edge. Sculpted of brilliant gold and styled like coral, it can pierce tidal waves. For gifts so precious, the Ashray promised to protect the land as well as the sea.

name: Golden BrightFlame Spear (0 AC)
description: This spear burns with the bright flames of your powerful will. Wield it, or entrust it to those who share your fire.

name: Golden BrightFlame Spear (AC)
description: This spear burns with the bright flames of your powerful will. Wield it, or entrust it to those who share your fire.

name: Golden Carteret Spear
description: A blacksmith from Mythsong was comissioned to forge this spear for a special occasion. Each time you tap on it's tip, the spear will chime with the notes of a wedding march. It's an odd feature to explain to a confused foe.

name: Golden Celestial Warrior's Spear
description: *No description*

name: Golden Champion's Spear
description: This glistening spear of light is awarded only to heroes of the highest respect.

name: Golden Clover Cleaver (Polearm)
description: You won't need the luck from a four-leaf clover to be able to slice through your enemies with THIS cleaver! Happy Lucky Day!

name: Golden Defenders Lance
description: This golden lance were forged to commenmorate Lord Balax'el's defeat in Swordhaven.

name: Golden Dragen's Adel
description: A spear named for the dignity of the Dragon who chose you as a Draco Knight. The blade is made of its crystalized breath.

name: Golden Dragon Glaive
description: Forged from the scales of an ancient golden dragon, this glaive is prized by dragonslayers and treasure hunters around the world.

name: Golden Dragon Scythe of Infinity
description: Your victory is unbelievable! To show our appreciation for reaching 1,000,000% funded (O_O!!!) on the AdventureQuest Worlds: Infinity Kickstarter, the team created this golden gift to share with ALL players!

name: Golden Dragon Spear
description: The Golden Dragon has been passed down from generation to generation, between dragon slayers, after the first ever dragon fall that the point of its blade. Rumor says that the blade harnessed the power from that dragon which gives the spear its golden hue.

name: Golden Dream Guardian Polearm
description: There are many creatures that stalk the lands of the Djinn Realm, and the Guardians of the Dream Palace protect all who dwell within. Golden versions of the Guardian's uniform are awarded to those who have saved the lives of those who dwell in the realm.

name: Golden Firebird's Great Axe
description: This axe, forged in the likeness of a great firebird, blazes with the heat of the rising sun. Only the worthy can wield the axe without it burning the skin off of their palms.

name: Golden Firebird's Spear
description: A glorious spear that, if used for evil and tyranny, will burst into flames. Your enemies will burn as you turn to ash with them.

name: Golden Halberd
description: This halberd's design was taken originally from a Horc design called 'poke stick'.

name: Golden Inquisitor's Spear
description: After succumbing to the lure of Gravelyn's darkness, former members of the Citadel Inquisitors are ready to answer Gravelyn's call to battle at any time, day or night. Though they may die, they know they will always return in her service.

name: Golden Purification
description: One Foe, Two Foe, Red Foe, Dead Foe!

name: Golden Scythe of the Sunborn
description: The Sunborn did not know that creatures of darkness were their enemies until they touched down on Lore's soil. These scythes leave scars on those who call the night home, cursing them to feel the scorch of the sun for the rest of their existences.

name: Golden Spear of Light
description: Those who walk in the light need never fear the shadows while wielding this golden spear.

name: Golden Spear of Virtue
description: The Light, glorified as a a symbol of Good and Virtue by the noble court of Swordhaven. Queen Lynaria was a beacon of Light, and dearly beloved by all who knew her. This spear honors her pure ideals.

name: Golden Star Polearm
description: A special type of starsword given to agile Star Captains and Upholders, it is something specialy made to keep thieves and unseen enemies from ambushing you. If they are spun in a 360 degree angle, it can also make a decent shield. Don't try this at home or anything near flammable.

name: Golden Star Scythe
description: Use this scythe with care because mental strength is needed to properly control its power.

name: Golden ZombieSlayer Spear
description: I wouldn't touch that zombie with a ten foot spear!

name: GoldenStag Warrior's Lance (0 AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the GoldenStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: GoldenStag Warrior's Lance (AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the GoldenStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: Golmoth's Polearm
description: The Dragon Princes of the Djinn Realm are feared among all of the draconic species on Lore. They possess a power rarely seen in our world… and not at all understood.

name: GonnaGetcha Trident
description: With a hack hack here and a slash slash there…

name: Grand Antaeus Spear (AC)
description: A great spear that pierced the hearts of a clan of giants once thought immortal. Dage the Evil forged this weapon with the intent to humble the invincible.

name: Grand Antaeus Spear (Non-AC)
description: A great spear that pierced the hearts of a clan of giants once thought immortal. Dage the Evil forged this weapon with the intent to humble the invincible.

name: Grand Necromancer's Spear (0 AC)
description: You have done the near impossible… mastered the arts of necromancy and ascended to the rank of Grand Necromancer. All without losing your mortality. For now.

name: Grand Necromancer's Spear (AC)
description: You have done the near impossible… mastered the arts of necromancy and ascended to the rank of Grand Necromancer. All without losing your mortality. For now.

name: GrandMaster Enchanted Spear
description: To become a GrandMaster it takes skill, a cunning eye, a sharp blade and a good fire retardant armor.

name: Great Spear Of Flame
description: "It burnses! It burnses!" It really does. It's a great spear of fire. It's gonna burn. Like a lot.

name: Greataxe of Dread
description: This ordinary weapon from Lord Reingold's lair is well-crafted and will prove useful in battle. A solid piece of loot!

name: Greater Bloodbeacon Polearm +5
description: You do not know what it is you seek to become, Hero. But please, continue!

name: Greater Necrotic Flame's Fang
description: These sacred spears were used to promote peace but now they've been tarnished and now force innocent people from their homes.

name: Greater Shadowflame Fang
description: These sacred spears were used to once promote peace but now they've been tarnished and now force innocent people from their homes.

name: Green Death of Time Scythe
description: When the grains of sand all fall to the bottom of the glass…well then your time is up.

name: Green Dragon Polearm
description: The courage of the Green dragon allows you to face to toughest monsters on Lore. Maybe with this, nothing will stop you! (But I doubt it).

name: Green Dragon Slayer's Halberd
description: Green Dragons have long been known to ally with evil, and are the favorite target of DragonSlayers. But when our world is under attack from an even greater threat, old rivalries must be put aside.

name: Greenguard Druid Polearm
description: Because the forest is a holy place to many, Greenguard Druids do there best to keep it healthy and clean for all those who dwell in it.

name: Grenwog DracoSpear
description: DracoGrenwog eggs have a habit of exploding into molten yolk splatter. It might have to do with their uncommon fusion. This spear is meant to be used for combat, but most slayers also use it to safely handle them from a distance.

name: Grenwog Guardian's Spear
description: Heroes across Lore challenge the Grenwog each year. But a very few see that the Grenwog is a beast to be admired and respected. As its Guardian, it is your duty to ensure the Grenwog's safety.

name: Grievous Fiend Spear
description: A dark spear, glowing with crimson power. The ancient magic of the Nation clashes with the power of the Fifth until one consumes the other. Both forces consider each other a worthy match.

name: Grim Psychophant's Scythe
description: A scythe lovingly forged in Grimskull's image. One of these days, it's going to take his head. Then, his diligent followers are going to violently play musical chairs with his throne.

name: Grim's Shadow Scythe
description: Legend says that this weapon was once imbued with power by Death himself. …and I believe that!

name: GrimDark Scythe
description: Congratulations hero! You've farmed enough to get the personal set of fellow player Doom Reign Doom!

name: Grimskull's Spear of Suffering
description: At its base is a spike that used to be at the bottom of a sneakily hidden. After years of collecting blood and torment, it's become a weapon worthy of wicked wielding.

name: Grimstone Spear
description: At its base is a spike that used to be at the bottom of a sneakily hidden. After years of collecting blood and torment, it's become a weapon worthy of wicked wielding.

name: Guandao of Slaying
description: A bladed polearm used to strike your enemies at a greater distance.

name: Guardian of Energy Spear
description: Mortals drawn to the Plane of Energy can tap into its power at will. The most skilled may become a Guardian of Energy, and serve only their Plane's Champion.

name: Guild Launch Flag
description: /cheer and hold thy Guild Launch Flag high, and prepare thy guild for the countless battles ahead. Slay more Dragons!

name: Guild Launch Lance
description: Slay more Dragons? Not a problem! This Guild Launch-exclusive weapon was entrusted upon you from your fellow Guildmates. Bring honor and glory to your guild!

name: Guilded Scythe
description: Awarded to those valiant Members who helped us test guild functionality during the Guilds PTR test!

name: Gungnir
description: Use the spear Gungnir to begin - or END - all of the wars you take part in.

name: Gunlance (AC)
description: Taking the phrase "Shots fired" to a whole new level!

description: Taking the phrase "Shots fired" to a whole new level!

description: Perfect for ceremonial occasions, but great on the battlefield too!

description: A weapon that only gleams gold in the hands of a true Hero. Few have seen it's true appearance after the unworthy spirited them away to a Kingdom of lies and liars.

name: Half-Dragon's Havoc
description: Designed so that no matter which why it's swung it will always strike with something sharp. Nythera covets this weapon. She feels it embodies her ability to handle all situations no matter what.

name: Hammer of Infinite Space (AC)
description: Good for breaking and entering, especially the breaking part.

name: Hammer of Infinite Space (Legend)
description: Good for breaking and entering, especially the breaking part.

name: Hand of the Polearm
description: Point out the obvious with this handy pole arm! Can also be used to tickle your opponents into a laughing fit.

name: Harbinger of Destruction Spear (0 AC)
description: The spear comes alive, sensing that you yearn for destruction. Be it the end of your enemies or the tearing down of fate, it will grant your dearest wish. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Harbinger of Destruction Spear (AC)
description: The spear comes alive, sensing that you yearn for destruction. Be it the end of your enemies or the tearing down of fate, it will grant your dearest wish. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Harlequin Warrior Scythe
description: If you want Heroes to respect you, show them you're serious.  Blow something up!

name: Harvest Scythe (2)
description: A beautiful scythe to use when harvesting the fields of Lore.

name: Harvester of Hearts
description: If you aim, go for the heart. Love, conflict, happiness, and hate have no meaning if there's no heart.

name: Hashi Trident
description: The elegant trident wielded by the Bridge Maiden, Hime Hashi. A rare find, even for the Yokai!

name: Havoc Scythe of Nulgath (AC)
description: The Thorns of Nulgath are a silent, deadly, almost invisible corps of elite assassins. You do not know they are hunting you until you feel their blade pierce through your side.

name: Havoc Scythe of Nulgath (Legend)
description: The Thorns of Nulgath are a silent, deadly, almost invisible corps of elite assassins. You do not know they are hunting you until you feel their blade pierce through your side.

name: HawkBlackwell's Scythe
description: Given to HawkBlackwell from J6 at DragonCon 2011!

name: Heart Reaper Scythe
description: Twin to the Shattered Soul Harvester, this scythe was brought into the underworld by a silent sailor, fighting his fate every step of the way. No one knows what became of him, and all that's left of him is this scythe. If you can find its twin… who knows what will happen to Death?!

name: Heartbroken Scythe
description: Poor pitiful souls, abandoned by love. May this blade mercifully deliver you from the house of pain.

name: Heavenly Hasher
description: Harness the power of light to continue the fight against Ebil! Don't give up, Hero!

name: Heavenly Spear of Nulgath
description: I will drive thee straight through my enemy!

name: Heavy Metal Necromancer Scythe
description: What's more metal than a rock concert full of head-banging undead? A necromancer who can bind their spirits and control them. FOREVER. (This item is color customizable)

name: Hellion Basilisk Trident (0 AC)
description: At the break of dawn, the Celestials carry the vampiric monarch from battle to rest. In this world, her weapon was finally able to protect the soft light she adored so much.

name: Hellion Basilisk Trident (AC)
description: At the break of dawn, the Celestials carry the vampiric monarch from battle to rest. In this world, her weapon was finally able to protect the soft light she adored so much.

name: Hellion Sun Iron Spear (0 AC)
description: The weapons of the glorious hunt are worn from centuries in the wilds. Over time, new weapons from all over the continent joined the fray as the Riders welcomed new members into their charge.

name: Hellion Sun Iron Spear (AC)
description: The weapons of the glorious hunt are worn from centuries in the wilds. Over time, new weapons from all over the continent joined the fray as the Riders welcomed new members into their charge.

name: Here There Be Dragons
description: ﻿Yarrrrr! Use th' compass points built into this trident to sail yer way through th' deep, dark Blacklce Oceans to th' Northlands. Ye may just cross paths w' a Frost Dragon… but it'll be th' LAST thing ye see!

name: High Axe of Dread
description: This ordinary weapon from Lord Reingold's lair is well-crafted and will prove useful in battle. A solid piece of loot!

name: High Nega Commander Spear
description: The energy given off by these weapons produce a subtle yet effective burst of nega waves which dance around the blade.

name: Hinokami Naginata (0 AC)
description: An heirloom spear connected to samurai by the flames of their souls instead of their blood. Its steel was scorched black by Dragon fire, transforming it into a naginata that cleaves the infinite.

name: Hinokami Naginata (AC)
description: An heirloom spear connected to samurai by the flames of their souls instead of their blood. Its steel was scorched black by Dragon fire, transforming it into a naginata that cleaves the infinite.

name: Hockey Stick
description: This staff once belonged to the great and terrible warrior Jaysun. It was said long ago that anyone who holds his power would be impossible to kill.

name: HolloEnergy Blade
description: A creative weaponmaker by trace, Hollo decided to make something unique. Using some complicated time manipulation, powerful concentrated energy was effectively frozen in time, allowing Hollo to create this.

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster's Spear (0 AC)
description: There's a tale of a Beastmaster dying as they stabbed their weapon into a massive behemoth's heart, and together, they overcame the Shadow Fiend's trial. Which weapon was it? Perhaps you're holding it in your hands. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster's Spear (AC)
description: There's a tale of a Beastmaster dying as they stabbed their weapon into a massive behemoth's heart, and together, they overcame the Shadow Fiend's trial. Which weapon was it? Perhaps you're holding it in your hands. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn Bis In Idem
description: The Hollowborn Judge is sometimes brought into combat to punish the defendant. They must use weapons instead of words. Apply the sentence more than once to make the consequences more severe.

name: Hollowborn Consummatum Est
description: The Hollowborn Judge is sometimes brought into combat to punish the defendant. They must use weapons instead of words. Apply the sentence more than once to make the consequences more severe.

name: Hollowborn Dark Scythe (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Dark Scythe (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as Hollowborns!

name: Hollowborn Dragonknight Scythe
description: An elaborate weapon that rarely sees battle. Outside of scythes being difficult to wield by amateurs, they're known to be used by a spiteful knight who slays the partners of Dragonlords out of jealousy.

name: Hollowborn DragonSlayer's Spear
description: After the Shadowlord defeated a wounded Hollowborn DragonSlayer, this spear was the only thing that remained…

name: Hollowborn Drake Halberd
description: A weapon typically used by aspiring Dragonlords who protect the nests and castle forts. They house the Dragon eggs of the trainees' seniors.

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Scythe (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Scythe (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as Hollowborns!

name: Hollowborn Frost Queen's Scythe (0 AC)
description: It is said this scythe is the only weapon capable of breaking the Queen's eternal ice. Her Highness holds both your doom and your salvation.

name: Hollowborn Frost Queen's Scythe (AC)
description: It is said this scythe is the only weapon capable of breaking the Queen's eternal ice. Her Highness holds both your doom and your salvation.

name: Hollowborn Longinus
description: A spear transformed by the numerous struggles of the wielder. The deadly thorns and elegant vines are a reflection of the trials experienced by those who held it in the past.

name: Hollowborn Pitchfork
description: You defied death to farm. That's dedication.

name: Hollowborn Reaper's Scythe
description: Fallen warriors seeking for justice or revenge… it can be hard to tell the difference. Trained specially to fight infernal creatures, the Fiend Reaper is both slayer and puppetmaster. (Item does 40% more damage to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Hollowborn Rider's Lance
description: Kasebel says: Fine, take it, but don't you dare break my weapon. There will be no second chance for you, Hollowborn.

name: Hollowborn Shadow Shaper's Scythe
description: A fallen mage, now in servitude of the darkness and what lies there … A shadow manipulator who fuses them with his own mana, able to create and shape unique weapons, and strangely resistant minions. It is not common to see him in daylight, but hope never to find him in the darkness of night.

name: Hollowborn Shadow Shaper's Spear
description: A fallen mage, now in service of the darkness and what lies there …A shadow manipulator who fuses them with his own mana, able to create and shape unique weapons, and strangely resistant minions. It is not common to see him in daylight, but hope never to find him in the darkness of light.

name: Hollowborn Soul Taker
description: You can feel an unending thirst for power as you hold this weapon. "Cut down your enemies and grow stronger, like the one who held it before you" - Lae

name: Hollowborn Spear
description: I wonder where he got this…

name: HollowBorn Valkyrie's Spear
description: Without darkness, light cannot truly shine.

name: Hollowborn Vampire Scythe
description: Death (well, UNdeath) helps to provide power to the Hollowborn Vampire. Who knows what they are going to use that power for…

name: Hollowborn Vindicator Spear
description: At the end of a world, the Shadow Fiend watched all of Lore undergo a trial. In the final throes of certain death, the first and only Hollowborn Vindicator pulled this spear out of their shadow.

name: Hollowborn Warden Spear
description: An effective weapon to attack at a distance, which can be used to reach through the bars of a prison cell. Hollowborn who are too dangerous to be allowed freedom are well-acquainted with the spear's point.

name: Hollowsoul Lance
description: Hollowsoul Knights specialized in the ancient art of Jousting. This lance's regal design has been unaltered for ages, even before the Castle's collapse.

name: Holly Trident
description: It's a Holly, Jolly Frostval!

name: Holy Blessing Spear
description: The spookier the doll-like face, the holier the blessing.

name: Honra Selvagem Spear
description: Simple but effective.

name: Horc Hacker
description: The brutality of Horcs is evident in the design of their weapons.

name: Hun'Gar's Polearm
description: Fashioned from a tough obsidian-like material, a pointed mace like this can smash down boulders in just a single swing, saving time and energy when mining and crushing foes.

name: Hunger of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Nulgath's reach stretches across the length and breadth of Lore, even into the deepest reaches of Darkovia. There, the Hunger await.

name: Hunger of Nulgath (AC)
description: Nulgath's reach stretches across the length and breadth of Lore, even into the deepest reaches of Darkovia. There, the Hunger await.

name: Hunting Spear
description: Hunt some food or hunt your enemy. This pointy stick can do both.

name: Hyaline Spear
description: Cut your opponents with this spear… and if it shatters cut'em with the shards!

name: Hydra Spear
description: This spear is crafted from the scales of the Hydra.

name: Ice Dragon Polearm
description: The courage of the Ice dragon allows you to face to toughest monsters on Lore. Maybe with this, nothing will stop you! (But I doubt it).

name: IceDragon Breath Scythe
description: Taken from a lair in the Northlands, the Ice Dragon Breath Scythe harnesses the icy chill of the most feared dragon throughout the land of Lore.

name: IceShard Slicer
description: The type of ice sickle that you truly don't want to reign down upon your head!

name: IceStorm ShatterSpear (0 AC)
description: The frozen Northlands builds the fiercest warriors. No amount of cold will stop these generals from conquering.

name: IceStorm ShatterSpear (AC)
description: The frozen Northlands builds the fiercest warriors. No amount of cold will stop these generals from conquering.

name: Icewater Trident of Nautica
description: A legendary three pronged staff that can command the seas. If it is in the hands of sailor, a safe odyssey back home is guaranteed.

name: Iconoclast
description: Crystal wings, bright green metal… if this spear doesn't say "individual", I don't know what does.

name: Icy Frostlorn Raider Lance
description: The Winter Raiders use this style of weapon in fighting off the great white wyrms of the northlands.

name: Icy Frostlorn Scythe
description: The icy rift has spilled not only monsters into Lore, but also LOOT! Happy Frostval!

name: Icy Infernal Spear
description: Don't let it being made of ice cold your judgment, this is a mighty weapon.

name: Idalion's Flame Halberd
description: Balanced for both reach and ruin, this polearm was forged beneath the shadow of Idalion’s wings as the flames roared.

name: Ignited Guardian Lance
description: Hot to the touch, only the truest and bravest guardians may wield this weapon.

name: Illustrious Grandeur
description: This is the light of a resilient soul, and a face that screams that it exists. The last sunset approaches, but it isn't the end. Given a little hope and just enough time, nothing is impossible.

name: Iluminated Scythe
description: The blade only glows when gripped by the Light Mage whose power is then transferred to it.

name: Immortal Sacrificer Tepoztopilli
description: Dage the Evil fancies the Beast half of his soul to be the fabled Dark Sun the Immortal Sacrificers speak of. He forged a spear to match their preferences. It can pierce armor, and its victims drown in their own blood.

name: Immortalis Magus' Scythe
description: By the power of blood, breath, and bone, these dark magic users seek the ultimate prize: immortality… and they do not care who they must hurt to achieve it.

name: Imperial Assassin's Spear
description: A royal weapon that has taken the lives of Champions. When the First Champion of Energy died, his children spitefully broke the spear apart, and used the gold to craft their electrified crowns.

name: Imperial Naginata
description: The use of a Naginata is characterized by its sweeping movements of both power and grace.

name: Infamous Revenge
description: Revenge is a dish best served on the battlefield.

name: Infantry Pole Axe
description: This is a standard poleaxe of an infantry soldier.

name: Infernal Devourer Scythe
description: Infernal Devourers are voracious. That you were able to wrest this scythe away from your opponent speaks volumes about your skill in battle.

name: Infernal Harbinger's Howl
description: The fires of the Underworld have turned you into an Infernal Deathbringer. All who see you will fear.

name: Infernal Underworld Poleaxe
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Infernal Underworld Trident
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Infernal Wanderer's Scythe
description: This was once a Celestial Wanderer's scythe. Everything they did was in the name of the Bright One, so why did horns grow where wings should have sprouted?

name: Infernal Warlord's Polearm
description: An elite corps of Underworld Battlemages, the Infernal Shadow Warlords can summon infernal creatures from the place between worlds.

name: Infinita Mortem Scythe
description: The Shinigami is never seen without their reaper.

name: Infinite Joust
description: READY! AIM! JOUST!

name: Infinity Titan Mind Spear
description: The hardest choices requires the stronger will. The end is near, but you have the strength of will to act on those choices. Never forget.

name: Inquisitor Captain Short Polearm
description: *No description*

name: Inquisitor Guard's Spear
description: *No description*

name: Intergalactic Harvester Spear
description: Hired by the Furbles, these mercenaries follow them from world to world over what the Furbles leave behind.

name: Interstellar Knight Pike
description: Protect Lore as you fight throughout all of space and time. Bestowing your opponent, converging time around them to devastate your foes!

name: Ionic Spear (0 AC)
description: Some of the most powerful forces on our world are too small to see… but Ionic Warriors can manipulate the very building blocks of energy and matter to ensure they are victorious.

name: Ionic Spear (AC)
description: Some of the most powerful forces on our world are too small to see… but Ionic Warriors can manipulate the very building blocks of energy and matter to ensure they are victorious.

name: Iron Spear
description: The fearless guards of Swordhaven are known to wield such heavy spears.

name: Iron Spear of Chaos
description: This spear has been corrupted to the core!

name: Ixionidae GravaScythe
description: A noble golden crescent that was once fused with a star, used to cull comets and asteroids. That star died, and turned into a weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Ixionidae NeutroScythe
description: A noble golden crescent that was once fused with a star, used to cull comets and asteroids. That star died, and turned into a weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Ixionidae StarScythe
description: A noble golden crescent that was once fused with a star, used to cull comets and asteroids. That star died, and turned into a weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Jack O Poison Scythe
description: Jack be nimble, Jack be quick, especially if he sees you wielding this.

name: Jack O Scythe
description: Scythe to meet you. Don't let the gourd hit you on the way out.

name: Jade Scythe
description: Made by Bido, this jade scythe is filled with the fiery flames of one of the most unusual volcanoes in Lore - and only Bido knows where it is!

name: Jagged Reaper of Nulgath
description: Its barbed, of course. What else were you expecting?

name: Javelin
description: If you're going to throuw something at an opponent, why not make sure they can't get back up after it hits them? This javelin will get you over obstacles and ensure your enemies can't come back at you!

name: Jaw of Depravity
description: A scythe shaped like the crooked jaw of an indulgent beast. It seeks to embrace your warmth with claws and teeth.

name: Jolly Prismatic Frostval Pike (0 AC)
description: Frostval is a time to spend with family and friends before you go off on your next adventure. Grab your sharpest blade and put on your your brightest smile! (This item is color customizable.)

name: Jolly Prismatic Frostval Pike (AC)
description: Frostval is a time to spend with family and friends before you go off on your next adventure. Grab your sharpest blade and put on your your brightest smile! (This item is color customizable.)

name: Judgement Scythe
description: Reap your just rewards! This mammoth scythe is only awarded to ruthless Undead Champions who, despite all incredibly unfair odds, have never given up. Your dedication is evident.

name: Judgement Wheel Scythe
description: Forged from samples obtained from DragonFable, this scythe will be your judge, jury, and executioner.

name: Jus Divinum Polearm
description: Extend your reach, and your threat, with this double axe polearm. Disable your enemy and enact divine law and judgment on him or her. No one can escape Jus Divinum. No one.

name: Justified Victory Scythe
description: This weapon was seen as a subtle insult towards the Queen of Victory. Some hoped that she would be extraordinary, perhaps even a Dragonlord. Those dreams died, but ordinary people can still achieve the extraordinary.

name: Kabasaran Polearm
description: Wentira had its own humble beginnings, and has no wish to hide or disregard them. These aged and battle weathered weapons have protected their home for time immemorial.

name: Kabocha Killer Naginata
description: A naginata from a pumpkin patch across the sea. Their gourds are possessed with the need to be revered. Castles will be built to honor the new Kabocha King!

name: Kabocha King Naginata
description: A naginata from a pumpkin patch across the sea. Their gourds are possessed with the need to be revered. Castles will be built to honor the new Kabocha King!

name: Kaiju Slayer Spear
description: Ready to use against any strange creature that might want to attack Lore.

name: Kalestri Polearm
description: A gilded three-pronged trident. While it was most likely used in cult rituals, it is sturdy enough to snap a sword in two if caught in the prongs.

name: Karmic Retribution (AC)
description: What goes around…

name: Karmic Retribution (Legend)
description: What goes around…

name: Kartherax Scythe
description: At first glance, it looks like a scythe, but I'm sure it has other uses. Like…underwater basket weaving?

name: Kasuari Spear
description: Traditionally made of straw, Ewer clothing and accessories are worn by the men and women of Western Nunsantara for ceremonies.

name: Kathool's Spear Breaker
description: "KATHOOL!"

name: Kikuzu Lance
description: Curved from the cherry wood, The Kikuzu's single ring on the blade is to bring good luck. Or possibly doom… The translation is Shaky.

name: Killer Pitchfork
description: Perfect for Krampus to lovingly poke you, no intentions of stabbing whatsoever!

name: Kindled Spear of Embers
description: This spear was crafted by one of Pyralis' pyromancers out of super-heated lavarock.

name: KingSlayer's Anguish (0 AC)
description: The KingSlayer is an eldritch warrior feeds on those of royal blood, stealing their innate power and gifts.

name: KingSlayer's Anguish (AC)
description: The KingSlayer is an eldritch warrior feeds on those of royal blood, stealing their innate power and gifts.

name: Kiss of Venom
description: This blade of this scythe contain enough venom to send its victim into paralyzed state.

name: Kisshoten Naginata
description: A spear that delivered an era of prosperity to the Yokai Isles when it was used to extinguish the life of an evil Dragon. Legends say that a new era of happiness will be delivered when it tastes the blood of a Dragon once more.

name: Kitty's Last Lunch
description: Kitty Yu-Yule coughed and this came out. I'm… pretty… sure… this was wielded by the last Hero who tried to defeat her.

name: Knight's Pike
description: A basic pike for the discerning Knight of the realm.

name: Knight Spear
description: The old fashioned way of making a meat skewer hasn't gone out of style.

name: Kogane no Yari
description: Wielded by the soldiers of Yokai Isle.

name: Komokuten's Star Spear
description: A spear made from the White Tiger's wrath. It seeks to punish evil alongside a worthy master. The original wielder was said to have guarded the western skies of the Yokai Realm.

name: KotaPon Prize C
description: Oooh! You've won an Anamalous Spear from the KotaPon GachaPon machine!

name: L'amour Scythe
description: What's a Mage in love suppose to do?

name: Laevateinn
description: An artifact from Death's realm, this staff slew Baldr and is ready to taste the blood of all your foes, too!

name: Lán sè Shu Naginata
description: It is the Year of the Rat, and these Ninja are celebrating!

name: Lança de Iara
description: A lance made of enchanted bronze. If you fall into a river, cling to this spear. It'll float, and guide you safely to shore.

name: Lanca Dos Mortos Vivos
description: A spear made from the branch of one of the Underworld's many living dead trees. It punishes those who failed to value gift of life.

name: Lance of Divine Heart
description: During Heroes Heart Day tourneys, courtiers engage in jousts as they recite quotes from Valentidus Sr. “It was not the thorn bending to the honeysuckles, but the honeysuckles embracing the thorn.”

name: Lance of Doom Reborn
description: This lance rose from the shade of the eclipse. It calls for a new partner with a desire for vengeance as dark as its own. Chained to your hands, it becomes an extension of your will…or rather, "our" will.

name: Lance Of Gourds
description: When Barktrin Village celebrated its first harvest, a nasty Pumpkin Lord attacked because he was not invited. When the townspeople finally did, he presented its most devoted warrior with spear containing a fraction of his power. Its pumpkins are still ripe to this day.

name: Lance of Hatoth
description: The spirit of Hatoth imbues this lance with extra power.

name: Lance Of Hearts
description: I wouldn't take this set of cards with you. You might be accused of cheating. Trust me. I know my stuff.

name: Lance of Lizard Piercing
description: The best way to make ANY dino sore is with a sharp skewer!

name: Lance Of Prevarication
description: Only the most worthy Seraphic Paladins will battle to get this weapon. Personally crafted by their Leader, it is a gift from Laken to all those who vow to keep Lore safe from Ancient Evils.

name: Lance of Serepthys
description: The spirit of Serepthys imbues this lance with extra power.

name: Lance of the Depths
description: From out of the depths, a terror rises: a ghostly hand grasps this lance aimed directly at your heart. Do not fear… it is a gift from Neso, the Water Avatar, to aid you in battle.

name: Lance of the Patriots
description: Lore is the land of the free (to play MMO)! This lance shows your patriotic spirit but should not be brought to any football game.

name: Lance of the Sun
description: Sear your opponents in battle having them leave boiling mad.

name: Lance of Time
description: Rip through the annals of time, rewrite history, change the past or save the future.

name: Lava Star Polearm
description: Forged by Tana in the very heart of the Lore's Sun. This starsword is special. It's Hilt contains fragment of Fiamme's elemental essence.

name: Lava Star Scythe
description: Forged by Tana in the very heart of the Lore's Sun. This starsword is special. It's Hilt contains fragment of Fiamme's elemental essence.

name: Lavamorph Venom
description: This lava rock scythe holds lava within it which can be released as another means of attack or block your foe off while fleeing.

name: Lavastorm's Reach
description: Use the power of the storm to pull your enemies to you… then incinerate them!

name: Leeching Earth
description: Why one should always raise plants with radioactive water; they turn out much cooler!

name: Legacy Spear
description: This magical spear was wielded by the same warrior over many generations. If he was ever struck down in battle, he rose again as a new fighter to wield his spear once again.

name: Legendary Knight's Pike
description: These brave soldiers swear to defend King Alteon, Queen Lynaria and all of Swordhaven from any danger.

name: Legendary Retribution
description: Blud stained and brawl mangled the Legendary Retribution relentlessly serves its master whether it be Good, Evil, or Chaos.

name: Legion Beast's Fang Spear
description: From deep within the shadows of the Underworld, the Beasts of the Legion stalk their prey, slaying swiftly and silently. To slay the beast, you must BECOME the beast.

name: Legion Crypt Key Polearm
description: Capable of producing frost upon touch, the very blades must be the reason why the grass is so icy before winter. No wonder the Legion favors these.

name: Legion DeathFiend's Scythe
description: Legion DeathFiends are sworn body and soul to Dage the Evil's Undead Legion. They stalk the edges of the Underworld looking for unwary victims.

name: Legion DeathFiend's Spear
description: Legion DeathFiends are sworn body and soul to Dage the Evil's Undead Legion. They stalk the edges of the Underworld looking for unwary victims.

name: Legion Devourer of Souls Scythe
description: Not all souls captured for the Legion go to Dage. Some of his most fiercest warriors consume souls in an effort to gain more power.

name: Legion DoomBringer Polearm
description: Slice your enemies TWICE as fast with this dual-bladed Legion Polearm!

name: Legion Evocatus's Hasta (0 AC)
description: The Evocatus are loyal Legionnaires who voluntarily choose to serve Lord Dage after the end of their mortal lives. Eternal servitude to their lord is the greatest honor in undeath.

name: Legion Evocatus's Hasta (AC)
description: The Evocatus are loyal Legionnaires who voluntarily choose to serve Lord Dage after the end of their mortal lives. Eternal servitude to their lord is the greatest honor in undeath.

name: Legion Lich Lord's Scythe
description: A scythe worthy of Dage himself.

name: Legion Necrophoenix Scythe
description: A truly cursed scythe, forged with the bones of a phoenix that could not outrun death. It's rare to see Death so intent on trapping its quarry, but they've always had a grudge against these fiery birds.

name: Legion Star Polearm
description: A special type of starsword given to agile Star Captains and Upholders, it is something specialy made to keep thieves and unseen enemies from ambushing you. If they are spun in a 360 degree angle, it can also make a decent shield. Don't try this at home or anything near flammable.

name: Legion Star Scythe
description: Use this scythe with care because mental strength is needed to properly control its power.

name: Legion Vampire Scythe
description: Legion Vampires are unlike any other. Brutal, remorseless, and cruel, Vampires brandish this monumental scythe as a fair warning to anyone foolish enough to cross their path.

name: Legion War Wraith Spear (0 AC)
description: The War Wraiths' spears pulse cold from gathering souls that still yearn for the rush of battle. They cling to the steel, desiring further glory.

name: Legion War Wraith Spear (AC)
description: The War Wraiths' spears pulse cold from gathering souls that still yearn for the rush of battle. They cling to the steel, desiring further glory.

name: Legion Wolf Scythe
description: Even wolves want to be members of Dage's Legion.

name: Legion Wrath Scythe
description: Dage's rage knows no bounds. Channel it as you slice through your opponents!

name: Lengjing's Pike
description: Meant to resemble the wind blowing this elegant staff not only protects but also could be displayed on a wall.

name: Lesser Bloodbeacon Polearm (Polearm)
description: You do not know what it is you seek to become, Hero. But please, continue!

name: Leviasean Pike
description: For those Knights whose tastes lie in range over close quarters, they can call upon the Leviasea to grant them this mighty polearm.

name: Leviathan Domination Spear

name: Leviathan's Bane

name: Leviathan's Lightning
description: Zeon forged this ethereal scythe with the intent of slaying some world ending creature capable of frightening even the mightiest of elder dragons. Inspired by LanceDrake286 suggestion and art done by Pinwheel.

name: Leviathan Warrior's Trident
description: These leviathan patrol the deeps making sure that none enter their most sacred spaces.

description: Lightning strikes true and freely. You can't catch this one in a bottle.

name: Lich Lord's Scythe

name: Light Spear

name: Light Void Reverent Spear

name: Lightning Helix Spear

name: Lightning Mage Spear
description: Seize the power of lightning from the sky! Using electrical magic hamess the bolts and from them into weapons.

name: Lightning Shenlong Halberd
description: A spear made for the kin of dragons, able to purify blood into water with a touch. It's why they can destroy life, guiltless and free. Their crimes turn into rain.

name: Lightwielder's Spear
description: This weapon of the Lightwielders glows with holy energy, ready to slay any undead in your path.

name: Linda Feather Fan
description: See people rocking, hear people chanting, feeling hot, hot, hot!!

name: Lobthulhu Scythe
description: Those lobster claws can pinch… especially when they're THIS big!

description: The best line of defense against the corrupt force of Chaos. They work to achieve Order and balance in the Mirror Realm..

name: Lord of Order Polearm (Quest)
description: The best line of defense against the corrupt force of Chaos. They work to achieve Order and balance in the Mirror Realm..

name: Lord Soul Spear (0 AC)

name: Love Harvester
description: Throw out the seeds of discord, and reap what you sow. Love has many edges, but not as sharp as the one you now hold.

name: Love's Gladiator Scythe
description: Reap love's reward with this lovely scythe.

name: Lovesick Soul Scythe
description: A love as relentless as your inevitable death.

name: Lu Niu's Taurean Spear

name: Lucky Staff

name: Luminous TideWalker's Spear (0 AC)

name: Luminous Warrior's Scythe (AC)
description: Illuminated by the love and loyalty they feel for their Lord, Luminous Warriors are shining examples of what it means to serve the Avatar of Light.

name: Lunar Lorekeeper Spear

name: Lusè Shu Naginata

name: Lycan Scythe of Hemorrhaging
description: A scythe used be the Legion of Lycans in Dage's army. They shall become the reapers of the Nation!

name: Magitech Dragon Reaper (0 AC)

description: A scythe that has yet to reach its full potential. The blueprints were made by engineers who are inventing ways to use time as fuel. There is a being out there who is Time itself, so if they can acquire one of its body parts…

description: A spear forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's horde. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Maizelord Scythe
description: This stalk of corn grew weird. It's curved, sharp, and cuts down crows. The plants are starting an uprising!

name: Makarah's Rancor Trident
description: A shark hunter's weapon of choice, always aiming for the gills. It's golden gleam suggests royal origins, but its dark edge is cursed by the grudges of dead leviathans.

name: Malacoda Necroment
description: This blade will pierce, poke, and prod you further towards the darkness! (This item has a low chance to play an animation when you use a skill AND will do more damage against Chaos enemies.)

name: Malani Polearm
description: When Malani Warriors, who usually fight on horseback, dismount to engage in battle with the Scarabian Knights, they prefer this polearm as it means the Knights can't get into close range. Then it's a Scarabian slaughter!

name: Malevolent Harbinger's Howl
description: The fires of the Underworld have turned you into an Infernal Deathbringer. All who see you will fear.(Color Custom)

name: Malignant Death Scythe (0 AC)
description: The scythe of a psychopomp gone mad. It reaps souls for the purpose of satiating greed and gluttony. An entire lost Kingdom is trapped in this blade alone.

description: The scythe of a psychopomp gone mad. It reaps souls for the purpose of satiating greed and gluttony. An entire lost Kingdom is trapped in this blade alone.

name: Mana Guardian's Spear
description: The Mana Core contains the most pure magic available. Any mage drawing from the Core would be flooded with pure magic, overcome in a deluge of power which would burn through their physical, mental, and magical veins. It MUST be guarded to protect our world.

name: Mana Lance
description: Mana, the method of controlling the universal magical forces of nature, given form and shape.

name: Mana Overdriven Spear
description: Lore's lifeblood grants endless possibility to all. Combined with the endless scorn embodied by Shadowflame, this spear could maim the divine.

name: Mana Scorched Naginata
description: In a time of great calamity, Lore's own body became its enemy, and began splitting apart. The mana scored steel was torn from the ravaged ground, and fashioned into a volatile weapon that continues to pulse.

name: Mana Scythe
description: The living force of magic itself shaped into a brutal, slicing edge.

name: Mana Solace Paladin's Spear
description: A spear made manifest from one's mana and the light of their soul. This is a personal favorite of Tara's. Warlic's wisdom and Artix's "sense for cool" taught her how to summon it at the snap of a finger.

name: Manifestation of the Void
description: A twisted and living structure of bone, teeth, veins, and hunger. It's a dead creature from the Void that's slowly resurrecting itself.

name: MantaRay Paddle
description: With so many ships traveling in and out of Lolosia there's always a need for new First Mates… I wonder what keeps happening to the old ones?

name: Marauder Spear
description: A rugged spear for a bandit.

name: Marsh Scythe
description: A weapon found in the long lost depths of a marsh.

name: Martial Rokushakubo
description: A simple staff with weighted ends, meant to enhance your martial arts. An experienced fighter sees this as an extra limb.

name: Master Terror Guard's Spear
description: This relic gives off a very otherworldly aura. Warlic says it comes from another timeline… one very similar - but significantly different - than ours. (This item is fully color customizable.)

name: Master Twang's Energy Polearm
description: You managed to get out of Master Twang's Dojo with his own personal polearm! Well done!

name: Mecha Dragon Commander Tri-Spear
description: You are the commander of Mecha Dragons… all shall bow before you!

name: Mecha Kaiju Slayer Spear
description: Ready to use against any strange creature that might want to attack Lore.

name: Mechanical Star Polearm
description: A special type of starsword given to agile Star Captains and Upholders, it is something specialy made to keep thieves and unseen enemies from ambushing you. If they are spun in a 360 degree angle, it can also make a decent shield. Don't try this at home or anything near flammable.

name: Mechanical Star Scythe
description: Use this scythe with care because mental strength is needed to properly control its power.

name: Meme Ripper Scythe
description: When you're muted but your weapon does the talking!

name: Memehano's Blaze
description: Be careful.. you might burn yourself!

name: Memento Mori Pike
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever be forgotten…

name: Menacing Pitchfork
description: This belonged to a local villager who TRIED to help the Brethwren drive out the Stymphmalian Terror. Alas… he done got gobbled.

name: Mermaid's Hairpoon
description: Take to the depths and hear the mermaid's tale of love, scandal and pirate adventures. This harpoon is blessed with mermaid's hair , enought to help you defeat any foe. Just don't touch it, or you might have to join the lovely ladies in their homes beneath the waves.

name: Midnight Nutcracker's Polearm
description: More elegant than an actual weapon, this polearm still does damage.

name: Midnight Unicorn Scythe
description: Unicorns can sense pure souls, and have deeply protective instincts towards them. Death will come to those who wish to taint their dreams.

name: Mighty Curve Bladed Polearm
description: A polearm for use for slashing attacks. (Gives 5% more gold when equipped.)

name: Mighty Horc Hacker
description: The brutality of the Horcs is evident in the design of their weapons. This is so much more mighty than the Horc Hacker. Damage range increases to 35!

name: Mighty Infantry Pole Axe
description: This is a standard poleaxe of an infantry soldier. (Gives 5% more gold when equipped.)

name: Mindbreaker Lance

description: You are the ruler of Dragons… all shall bow before you!

description: You are the ruler of Dragons… all shall bow before you!

name: Mirrored ShadowFlame Fang
description: These sacred spears were used to promote peace but now they've been tarnished and now force innocent people from their homes.

name: Molten DragonSpear of Nulgath
description: The blade resembles the head of a dragon spewing flame. It's as if Nulgath trapped the beat in gold mid-attack. It pulse with fury.

name: Molten Mayhem Polearm
description: You've got the eye of the tiger in this stealth assassin armor. Always on the prowl, the cat-like reflexes of the Igneus Assassin are those of legends.

name: Molten Trident of the Deep (0 AC)
description: A trident made of burning iron. It can only be wielded safely underwater in near frigid temperatures. Otherwise, it'll burn your skin off.

name: Molten Trident of the Deep (AC)
description: A trident made of burning iron. It can only be wielded safely underwater in near frigid temperatures. Otherwise, it'll burn your skin off.

name: MonsterLord Scythe
description: In a different world, a different timeline, Drakath -- Champion of Chaos -- would have been the MonsterLord, heir to the Queen of Monsters. But this is not that world, and he has seized his own power, and his own destiny.

name: Morose Spear
description: Imperial by design, this style of polearm was once used by elite members of the Shadow Slayers. No other spear features gravity defying ribbons. A design inspired by Outlaw13th.

name: Mortal Fiend Fangs Spear
description: Big and sharp. A proper weapon for a high rank fiend.

name: Mortis Chronoscythe
description: A weapon made to reap stolen time. Phantom Chronomancers bring about their quarry's demise with a blade created from the concept of inevitability itself. A swing from this scythe will never miss.

name: Moumiya Scythe
description: If your mummy won't let you get one of these wicked scythes, you should ask your Daddy.

name: Mountain Dweller Spear
description: It's like, a spear. But with magic. So it's a MAGIC spear. It's kind of a big deal.

name: Mudluk's Prosperity
description: This polearm was forged with the webbed hands of the Mudluk tribe. The hook at the top is used for hunting and gathering, but more importantly, is a symbol of prosperity.

name: Mudluk's Tadpolearm
description: Swamp critters have clustered together, mutating into a living weapon that young Mudluks use for combat.

name: Murgish Shortspear
description: The Murgish blade design was a common design in ancient Mudluk villages, due to it's sharp edge and mutiple uses.

name: Mushroom Scythe
description: Why, yes. All giant white speckled mushrooms DO sprout intimidating blades from their caps. You just have to know the right time to pick them.

name: Mutated Rebirth Spear
description: The remains of the Creatures plaguing Astravia were forged into writhing weapons. They're still warm to the touch, have no mouths, but speak to your soul.

name: Mystical Frigid Scythe of Vengeance
description: If one is lucky, the weakness in your heart will be killed for you. If not, you'll have to do it yourself.

name: Mystical HydraSlayer Polearm
description: This polearm was crafted from the remains of one left by a fallen HydraSlayer.

name: Mystical HydraSlayer Trident
description: This polearm was crafted from the remains of one left by a fallen HydraSlayer.

name: Mystical Polearm of the Sunhawks
description: Discovered buried deep within a previously unknown tomb by the HarpySlayers while on assignment, these mystical weapons glow with a sinister purple light.

name: Mystical Warrior's Kamayari
description: To become the warrior you were truly meant to be, you must tap into otherworldly forces. Only then will you be able to unlock the power you need to achieve greatness!

name: Mystraven Scythe
description: A sleek and dark blade made for the hands of the quick and unpredictable. Those sorts once joined hands under the name of a raven but the feathers have since scattered

name: Narakan Fiend's Spear
description: Having risen from the deepest dethos of the Underworld, the Narakan Fiend has allied with Nulgath to destroy the Undead Legion.

name: Nation Dragonbane Scythe
description: Dragons are a uniquely powerful lifeform, blessed with power and purpose - perfect for the Fiends to devour and use. Members of the Nation seek to slay them and use their parts to make weapons that embody their might.

name: Nation Night Screamer (0 AC)
description: A scythe made from a Nightmare Fiend's skull. It's bone and cranial fluid solidified into a weapon that can tear into the spatial fabric of one's mind. The Nation will reach into your dreams.

name: Nation Night Screamer (AC)
description: A scythe made from the skulls of Nightmare Fiends. Their bones and cranial fluid were solidified into weapons that can tear into the spatial fabric of one's mind. The Nation will reach into your dreams.

name: Nation Phalanx Spear (AC)
description: Often the first weapon thrown during a group scuffle, a small scale battle, or a full blown war. Most Nation members don't know that this was a tradition of warfare in ancient times.

name: Nation Phalanx Spear (Non-AC)
description: Often the first weapon thrown during a group scuffle, a small scale battle, or a full blown war. Most Nation members don't know that this was a tradition of warfare in ancient times.

name: Nation Ritualist Spear
description: A weapon of battle, and a tool for the ceremonies of ritualists. They carve the flesh of ancient beasts, and use their life blood to engrave runes on stone.

name: Nation's Draconic Halbardier Spear
description: The fang of the Nation's Dragons. A blade that smothers the flames of prideful beasts.

name: Naturebound Qiang
description: The Terran Dragonlords' weapon of choice. Being a branch shed by their partner Dragon, it is able to tap into the deepest roots of Nature magic.

name: Naval Reaper Black Flag
description: Avast! The seven seas need plunderin' and set sail from Lolosia and fight the mighty kracken while searchin' for treasure!

name: Nebula Paladin's Trident
description: To punfinity… and BEYOND!

name: Nebula Reaper
description: Made from starstuff and grains of sand from Chaos Lord Iadoa's hourglass, the Nebula Reaper will destroy your enemy… in the past, present, AND future.

name: Necro Paragon's Poleaxe (0 AC)
description: Are you ready to fulfill your destiny and join Dage in the fight for souls and the glory of the Underworld? It's not like you have a choice though.

name: Necro Paragon's Poleaxe (AC)
description: Are you ready to fulfill your destiny and join Dage in the fight for souls and the glory of the Underworld? It's not like you have a choice though.

name: Necrostar Scythe

name: NecroTech D00MSPEAR
description: Using Shadowscythe technology, defeated allies are converted into mindless undead cyborgs. Defiance is futile; supremacy is inevitable. (Shadow series gen 1)

name: Necrotfinger's Scythe

name: Necrotic Caster Grave Spade
description: Well those graves aren't going to dig themselves are they now.

name: Necrotic Flame's Fang
description: These sacred spears were used to once promote peace but now they've been tarnished and now force innocent people from their homes.

name: Necrotic Naginata of Doom
description: A myth sleeps in this Naginata, one of fallen civilizations, a lost future, and the flames of vengeance. A Doom Spirit is not trapped to this blade, but its spite is.

name: Necrotic Scythe of Doom
description: Sometimes the Deadtech makes someone all-the-way-dead… this is what they end up like. No-one is really sure why.

name: Necrotic Scythe of Scourge
description: Time to dry off the world and cast a plague on it!

name: Necrotized Scythe
description: The blade of this scythe is tipped with the razor-sharp obsidian claw of darkness dragon and embellished with glaring skulls. It thirsts for the blood of your enemies.

name: Neon Scythe of Revontheus (0 AC)
description: Found in the Underworld, this scythe gives the Revontheus the skills and deception needed to make the final strike against members of Dage's Legion.

name: Neon Scythe of Revontheus (AC)
description: Found in the Underworld, this scythe gives the Revontheus the skills and deception needed to make the final strike against members of Dage's Legion.

name: Neon Spectrum Stick
description: By the power of Rainbows!

name: Neverborn Necromancer's Scythe
description: A neverbom soul raised from limbo, torn apart, and fastened into a scythe that calls to others with its false light. The scythe is dipped into a forbidden realm, reaping the materials needed to continue dark deeds.

name: Neverborn Scythe
description: A spine tingling scythe for any wanna be Necromancer.

name: New Love at First Scythe
description: This magical bladed staff is normally used by the rare breed of wizards known as Romance-mancers.

name: NibbleOn Guardian Lance
description: You've been given the task to defend NibbleOn!

name: Night Mare Scythe
description: Binky shall NOT rise again!

name: Nightcaller Scythe
description: Summon the creatures of the night to battle with this deadly scythe!

name: Nightshade Staff
description: It's nice to have walking stick support with such a heavy load of of bodies on your back.

name: Northlands Hunting Spear
description: Crafted by the people of the Northlands for hunting the creatures of the frozen north. A great way to bring back your primal instincts!

name: Nosferatu Clan Scythe
description: These vampires care not for royal garb or flamboyant parties. Only hunting prey for their next meal.

name: Noxus Psychophant's Spear

description: A simple two-handed halberd forged by Dage the Evil, which gains new meaning when you learn that it's meant for Warriors who are two souls in one body.

name: Nyx Aura Halberd (Non-AC)
description: A simple two-handed halberd forged by Dage the Evil, which gains new meaning when you learn that it's meant for Warriors who are two souls in one body.

description: Gives a whole new meaning to what defines a pole"arm". The O-dokuro Glaive is a pole-arm made from his fore-arm!

name: Oasis Storm Spear
description: This is a gift from a deified Pharaoh, which allows the wielder to change the direction of the Sandsea's wind. The tide of battle will become yours to control.

name: Oblivion Bane Spear

name: Oblivion Spear of Revontheus
description: (Color Custom Trim) Even the holiest of beings fall at the power of this spear. Not even the champion of light has the ability to stop this weapon of destruction.

name: Obsidian Polearm
description: Not much is know about how these weapons came to be only that their strength is immeasurable and jewels engraved in them are older than the mountains.

name: Obsidian Rhiannon's Edge (0 AC)
description: Centaur warriors have long been some of Lore's fiercest and fastest fighters. With 4 hooves and as many blades as they can carry, they are a force to be reckoned with.

name: Obsidian Rhiannon's Edge (AC)

name: Ocean's Heart Polearm
description: Slice through your enemies like a whirling, watery storm!

name: Octarine Scythe (AC)

description: Weapon of Odanata kind.

name: Ode to Joy Scythe (Non-AC)

description: A scythe build by innocent hands. It is meant to be a tool used to shear overzealous shrubbery but ended up having too much of a bite. Hans wonders if having so many Evil aligned guests at the inn rubbed off on him.

name: One Eyed DoomLance
description: Forged by an evil dark caster, the One Eyed DoomLance is believed to be the sole element responsible for mosh pits during punk rock concerts. This devious weapon was discovered during the live One-Eyed Doll event.

name: One Eyed Polearm
description: If you run with this thing, you're bound to poke another Eye out! This Rare weapon was discovered during the live One-Eyed Doll event.

name: Oni Hatamoto Naginata

name: Onyx Legion Wolf Scythe
description: Even wolves want to be members of Dage's Legion.

name: Onyx Star Scythe

description: Though the beings who wield these spears have the same origins as the Fiends of the Nation, their hatred for the spawn of Adimonde runs deep.

name: Orochi BladeMaster's Glaive
description: The blades that wear Orochi's name are considered its younglings, forged from materials taken from its living body. Depending on who's blood seeps into the blade and why, a new yokai will be born and the weapon will be its body.

name: Overclocked Energy Scythe
description: Imported from the MechQuest timeline by some shifty-eyed time-traveling fairies, this energy scythe can slice your enemies in two AND cauterize their wounds in an instant.

name: PaintBrush Polearm
description: You won 3rd Place in the Chaos Art Contest! Go forth and paint the world Chaotic with your paintbrush polearm!

name: Palladinum Champion's Pole
description: Those who brave their way through brawl after brawl deserve proper recognition.

name: Paragon Spear
description: When the minions harvest souls for Dage, not all are used. The Paragon fiends feed on the some of the discarded to gain more strength and power.

name: Paraíso Feather Fan
description: See, people rocking, hear people chanting, feeling hot, hot, hot!!

name: Parodian Guard's Polearm
description: The elite unit of the Shadowscythe Army, used mostly for guarding VIPs or putting down rebellions.

name: Permafrost Scythe of Skade
description: A Dragon Prince turned himself into a Dracolich. Through Ice Necromancy, his corpse became a living monument to an extinguished bloodline. His mind and soul were lost to the ravages of time, turning him into a fierce force of nature.

name: Pestilence Spear
description: The orb in the center of this spear's head is filled with a noxious fluid which will shrivel your flesh should it come in contact with the most necrotic of juices.

name: Petrified Autumn Wood
description: When Solrac was asked by the druids of the Cloister to create a weapon, he made this. Rather than forging a blade with a hammer and anvil, he used his green thumb and grew this deadly weapon, making it a naturally lethal addition to anyone's arsenal.

name: Petrified Fiend Spear (0 AC)
description: Ever hungry for power, the Petrified Fiend will do Nulgath's bidding until the end of time.

name: Petrified Fiend Spear (AC)
description: Ever hungry for power, the Petrified Fiend will do Nulgath's bidding until the end of time.

name: Phantom Chrono Scythe
description: A weapon made to reap stolen time. Phantom Chronomancers bring about their quarry's demise with a blade created from the concept of inevitability itself. A swing from this scythe will never miss.

name: Phoenix Rising Axe
description: The armaments of rulers long forgotten. In your hands, this warm steel achieves new life and glory - burning fresh scars into the battlefield.

name: Picante Feather Fan
description: See people rocking, hear people chanting, feeling hot, hot, hot!!

name: Piercing Azurite
description: Take your enemies down with style. The light will dance off the silvery highlights, the blues will cool them off and the thrust of the weapon will take them to eternity. Not a bad way to go, if you don't mind being vanquished.

name: Pike of Contempt
description: A pike through the chest is sure to make your foes know the disdain you have for them!

name: Pike of Pain
description: If your opponents can't come within reach, they'll never be able to make YOU feel pain!

name: Pike of the Shimmering Sands
description: Valoth, Guardian of the Djinn Realm, targets his enemies' weaknesses. He is undefeated in single combat, and hoped to someday become Crulon's second in command.

name: Pink Pony Star Lance
description: The point is sharp enough to pop a stomach with naught but a prick. And the soft handle prevents you from getting calluses.

name: Pink POSE! Pitchfork
description: Picking up hay never looked more fierce! /SLAY

name: Pink Strike Scythe
description: Oozing with adorableness, this terribly cute weapon will destroy your enemies from the inside out… with love!

name: Pinnacle Spear
description: The mountains can be treacherous, a long-range weapon is best choice.

name: Piston-Driven Polearm
description: Similar to the axe version, this polearm is designed to have massive piercing power.

name: Pitchfork
description: Used for bailing hay on the farm!

name: Plague Strike Scythe
description: Oozing with toxicity, this terrible weapon will destroy your enemies from the inside out.

name: Plaque Destroyer
description: For severe cases of tooth decay.

name: Platinum Dragen's Adel
description: A spear named for the nobility of the Dragon that knighted the Drakkar. The sharp tip is made from a piece of the Dragon's huge scales.

name: Platinum Magitech Dragon Reaper
description: A scythe that has yet to reach its full potential. The blueprints were made by engineers who are inventing ways to use time as fuel. There is a being out there who is Time itself, so if they can acquire one of its body parts…

name: Platinum Rider Lance
description: Every mounted warrior needs a lance to poke, prod and stab people with.

name: Platinum Star Polearm
description: A special type of starsword given to agile Star Captains and Upholders, it is something specialy made to keep thieves and unseen enemies from ambushing you. If they are spun in a 360 degree angle, it can also make a decent shield. Don't try this at home or anything near flammable.

name: Platinum Star Scythe
description: Use this scythe with care because mental strength is needed to properly control its power.

name: Platinum Stormbringer Halberd
description: Shards of unworthy iron and steel, shattered by the Stormbringer's armaments, rain down on the sea. Only the stars have glimpsed the duels fought in the shadow of the clouds.

name: Pluma de Boitata Staff (AC)
description: This amazing collection weapon mimics a bird with wings of fire!

name: Pluma de Boitata Staff (Legend)
description: This amazing collection weapon mimics a bird with wings of fire!

name: Plumas Mortais Verdes
description: Transforme-se (incluindo o campo de batalha) com estas penas de carnaval rosa enquanto você /samba sua vitória! Obrigado por apoiar o AQWorlds através da paymentez!

name: Poison Vapor Polearm
description: Legend has it that when this weapon was forged, the creator fell in love with a potion mistress. When she denied him, he forged this weapon and etched it with poison before dying of a broken heart.

name: Polar Permanence Scythe
description: A scythe forged under a persimmon tree in spring. It belonged to a traveling warrior who fell asleep in the lonely arms of Winter.

name: Polearm of Shimazu
description: Shimazu the Defiler was awakened by Malgor, but has proven to be no match for your might!

name: Polearm of the Forsaken
description: An elite cadre of sentient undead known as The Forsaken wield these weapons. Their front line is composed of polearm wielders, who's chops are so powerful that they can split shields down the middle.

name: Poleaxe of Dread
description: This ordinary weapon from Lord Reingold's lair is well-crafted and will prove useful in battle. A solid piece of loot!

name: Poleaxe of Randor
description: Randor the red likes axes - and he likes red! To celebrate the passing of another year of his own existence, Randor has chosen to share these passions by combining them into one awesome poleaxe for you!

name: Poleaxe of the Legion Beast
description: From deep within the shadows of the Underworld, the Beasts of the Legion stalk their prey, slaying swiftly and silently. To slay the beast, you must BECOME the beast.

name: Polish Hussar Spear
description: These noble warriors fight white honor and to the death to defend Lore.

name: Polychronic Magister's Scythe
description: Able to manipulate multiple simultaneous events with ease, the Polychronic Magister glides through space and time, compelling all they meet.

name: Polycrystalline Silicon Spear
description: Wafer-think sheets of polycrystalline silicon are used to capture and store solar energy from the white-hot rays of the Sandsea's desert sun.

name: Possessed Pitchfork
description: This belonged to a local villager who TRIED to help the Brethwren drive out the Stymphmalian Terror. Unfortunately, the pitchfork got coated in the beast's poison… and so did the villager. O_O

name: Potent Chaorruption
description: This scythe has been so infused with Chaos that it has taken on a deadly madness of its own. Do you dare weild it?

name: Pride of the Legion
description: Size DOES matter in the Undead Legion! Nothing can escape your reach with this massive polearm crafted from Obsidian Rocks and plenty of Solidified Souls.

name: Prime Galactic Scythe
description: This scythe can harvest the very stars above. Costs 1 million Gold due to the clarity of the star minerals in its core.

name: Prime Necrotic Flame's Fang
description: These sacred spears were used to once promote peace but now they've been tarnished and now force innocent people from their homes.

name: Prime Paintbrush Polearm

name: Prime ShadowFlame Fang
