name: Prime Spear of Awe! (AC)
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Primitive Stonehead Spear
description: Yeah, it's old school but this was high tech compared to rocks and clubs back in olden times.

name: Prince Darkon's Poleaxe
description: A weapon once belonged to the previous Prince of Astravia. The poleaxe has been left to collect dust in King Drago's possession after its owner's passing. Now with Drago gone, the weapon is yours.

name: Prisma Scythe
description: Use the force to mesmerize your enemies with this color-shifting spear crafting of polarized paladinum.

name: Prisma Spear
description: Use the force to mesmerize your enemies with this color-shifting spear crafting of polarized paladinum.

name: Prisma Spear of Victory
description: Freedom. Equality. Liberty for all!

name: Prismatic Cloudpiercer
description: Pierce the clouds… and your enemies with this magical polearm! Used exclusively by the Kanataka Warriors of Yokai Isle.

name: Prismatic Double Scythe
description: Double the blades, double the bloodshed!

name: Prismatic Fiendish Transcendence Scythe
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: Prismatic Havoc Scythe of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: The Thorns of Nulgath are a silent, deadly, almost invisible corps of elite assassins. You do not know they are hunting you until you feel their blade pierce through your side. (This item is color customizable)

name: Prismatic Havoc Scythe of Nulgath (AC)
description: The Thorns of Nulgath are a silent, deadly, almost invisible corps of elite assassins. You do not know they are hunting you until you feel their blade pierce through your side. (This item is color customizable)

name: Prismatic Keeper's Double-edged Blade
description: This magnetic polearm is capable of drawing power from the moon when it is at its highest during the night and can store a great deal of its energy for a long period of time, allowing its user to endure long-lasting days.

name: Prismatic Paint Polearm
description: You won 2nd Place in the Chaos Art Contest! Go forth and paint the world Chaotic with your Color-custom paintbrush polearm!

name: Prismatic Pitchfork
description: The colors of this pitchfork shift and change at your command!

name: Prismatic Pool Noodle
description: You'd think that combining the lightning and water would be dangerous. Not for the Thunderborn!

name: Prismatic Scythe of Thyton
description: This was the scythe created by Thyton in his Live Draw event in April of 2012. Thanks for attending!

name: Prismodian Guard's Polearm
description: The colorfully elite unit of the Shadowscythe Army, used mostly for guarding VIPs or putting down rebellions.

name: Psychic Domination Spear
description: Massive beasts fight for dominance in the churning sea. Yet a single tusk pointed at just the right angle can pierce right through their skull, and bring them to peace. The Adeptus that grew this spear out of their body will feast on the spoils for months to come.

name: Pumpkin Lance of Piercing
description: Once belonged to the Great Pumpkin Lord. This Lance makes your arm strong!

name: Punk Coal Elf's Scythe
description: It's a punk rock Frostval, and the Frostval trees are decorated with safety pins.

name: Purified ArchFiend's Spear (0 AC)
description: Even the darkest, most fiendish warrior can be turned to the light.

name: Purified ArchFiend's Spear (AC)
description: Even the darkest, most fiendish warrior can be turned to the light.

name: Purified HydraSlayer Polearm
description: This polearm was crafted from the remains of one left by a fallen HydraSlayer.

name: Purified HydraSlayer Trident
description: This polearm was crafted from the remains of one left by a fallen HydraSlayer.

name: Purified Polearm of Nulgath
description: SomeTHING has decided to lack onto this polearm, fusing with it. Word of warning, don't touch the eye.

name: Purified Scythe of Nulgath
description: A poisoned scythe once favored by a forest reaper, rumor has it that it was used to see everything that occurred in the forest it's owner called home. This was the cause of the disappearances of unlucky travelers, but now that the scythe has found it's way to you, are you any safer?

name: Purified Soulbinder Poleaxe
description: This weapon aids in the binding of souls, drawing them from the void - a window to which is visible within its head.

name: Pyroclastic BeastMaster's Spear (0 AC)
description: In the claws of beasts that sleep in the depths of volcanoes are armanents from ages past. The beasts often outlive their former mortal masters, and wait for a day when a new partner steps fearlessly into magma.

name: Pyroclastic BeastMaster's Spear (AC)
description: In the claws of beasts that sleep in the depths of volcanoes are armanents from ages past. The beasts often outlive their former mortal masters, and wait for a day when a new partner steps fearlessly into magma.

name: Qiang of Fortune
description: The Terran Dragonlords' weapon of choice. Being a branch shed by their partner Dragon, it grows steel bark and golden flowers as they age.

name: Quantum Force Spear
description: An unknown civilization used light as if it were steel, forging weapons that can withstand the crushing pressure of the domain between worlds. Who or what made them was lost when the worlds collided.

name: Quasar Piercer Spear
description: ﻿A cosmic spear that can pierce the fabric of space. They're aimed at planets that have gazed too closely at the center of all creation.

name: Queen's ArchSage Scythe
description: Scythes like this one were used as pendulums in a torture chamber the queen would use to kill treasonous criminals. The scythe slowly cut their bodies up to serve as a cruel reminder of betrayal. If you put your ear on this scythe, you could hear the criminals' screams.

name: Queen's Sage Scythe
description: Scythes like this one were used as pendulums in a torture chamber the queen would use to kill treasonous criminals. The scythe slowly cut their bodies up open to serve as a cruel reminder of betrayal. If you put your ear on this scythe, you could hear the criminals' screams.

name: QuickSpark Polearm
description: Legends foretold of a magical spear that could vanquish all the Evil in Lore. Could this be the weapon in that legend?

name: Rabid Spring Rockstar's Spear
description: Spring flowers? Sunlit groves? Gentle rain and sweet songs? NO. Rabid Rockstars like you are fueled by spikes, storms, and SCREAMS OF VICTORY! (Also maybe cute baby bunnies.)

name: Radiant Conviction
description: A lance of steel and Light, forged by the greatest smith's of Thelima City for its heroes. The weapon generates its own momentum allowing the wielder to pierce their enemies with incredible force despite standing still.

name: Radiant Lucian Spear
description: What is a spear made of light good for? Smiting, of course.

name: Rage Against the Scythe (AC)
description: Do you have FEELINGS? Do you wish you could murder WITH those feelings? I got you covered.

name: Rage Unleashed Scythe

description: Takes the term double rainbow to epic status.

description: Use this scythe with care because mental strength is needed to properly control its power.

description: You took his lance?!?! Better hide before he comes back!

name: Raptor Rider's Lance
description: Made of the bones of the undead dragons and nearly impossible to break.

name: Rare DeathHunter Scythe
description: This scythe will suck your soul right from you.

name: Räsvelg (0 AC)
description: The Warbringers of the Legion are not singular souls. Some are multiple Warriors fused together, and others were forged by Dage himself. They are a special existence, meant to bring an end of 'existence' itself.

name: Ravenloss Defender Scythe
description: A powerful scythe to show the ChaosWeavers Ravenloss will not fall!

name: Ray of Honor
description: A ray of the sun's light can be so much sharper than any blade.

name: Re's Long Stabber
description: "If you have a really big bow, this thing will make a great arrow. Or you can use it as a spear," Re said.

name: Re's Neck Snatcher
description: "I didn't get to use this one much to be honest, but it's pretty good for the job," Re said.

name: Reach
description: Looking for a long polearm with a wicked blade and attitude? Look no further. One sweep of this curvaceous, yet awe inspiring weapon will give you the upper hand in any attack.

name: Reanimancer Scythe
description: A scythe that drags the souls of the dead across the threshold, forcing life to return to old bones.

name: Reanimated Revenge
description: Forged from several parts of slain creatures, the scythe grows in size for every victim that falls to its blade.

name: Reaper's Edge of DOOM
description: This weapon was originally used by the Champion of Darkness. This scythe was commonly used in battle, due to its long range. When it cuts a foe, it absorbs their blood and becomes more powerful.

name: Reaper's Oath
description: A Reaper's oath promises death. It saves mortals from themselves. Lingering too long on the plane of the living twists their minds and souls. Everything that begins must end.

name: Reaper's Void Scythe
description: Pure void essence surges within this scythe.

name: Reaping Scythe of the Legion
description: The wind whistles as this scythe swings. This is the call of the reaper, and it sings in the name of the Legion and its Lord.

name: Reavers of Chaos
description: A poisoned scythe once favored by a forest reaper, rumor has it that it was used to see everything that occurred in the forest its owner called home. This was the cause of the disappearances of unlucky travelers, but now that the scythe has found this way to you, are you any safer?

name: Red Hot Chili Poker
description: From the road, to the sea, to the sky, this poker will have your enemies /yelling, 'HeyOW!' This polearm is too red hot to handle!

name: Red Naginata
description: An extremely long polearm traditionally used by samurai. So go ahead and reach for the stars; the Naginata is tall enough to do so!

name: Red Pitchfork 08
description: Happy Mogloween! This is the 1st Edition released during AQW's first Mogloween 2008!

name: Red Rocket Blade
description: Slice your opponent from a distance with glowing nanotech!

name: Red Skull
description: Bits of decayed flesh cling to the notched edges of the weapon. Whatever creature this was, the blade was put through it while it was still alive.

name: Red Tide Dragon Spear (0 AC)
description: When Marine Dragons fight, they tear off each other's fins, and retreat to regrow them. The fallen spines can be crafted into spears that can rip through the water like it's air.

name: Red Tide Dragon Spear (AC)
description: When Marine Dragons fight, they tear off each other's fins, and retreat to regrow them. The fallen spines can be crafted into spears that can rip through the water like it's air.

name: Resurrected Hockey Stick
description: This staff once belonged to the great and terrible warrior Jaysun. It was said long ago that anyone who holds his power would be impossible to kill.

name: Reversed Malignant Death Scythe (0 AC)
description: The scythe of a psychopomp gone mad. It reaps souls for the purpose of satiating greed and gluttony. An entire lost Kingdom is trapped in this blade alone.

name: Reversed Malignant Death Scythe (AC)
description: The scythe of a psychopomp gone mad. It reaps souls for the purpose of satiating greed and gluttony. An entire lost Kingdom is trapped in this blade alone.

name: Rhiannon's Edge
description: Centaur warriors have long been some of Lore's fiercest and fastest fighters. With 4 hooves and as many blades as they can carry, they are a force to be reckoned with.

name: Riftwalker Battle Spear
description: Riftwalkers are Atealan warriors who can cut reality with a single slash, and shatter dimensions with a punch. Powerful Riftwalkers can flash through reality with a single swing of their blade.

name: Riftwalker Density Blade
description: Riftwalkers are Atealan warriors who can cut reality with a single slash, and shatter dimensions with a single punch. Powerful Riftwalkers can flash through reality with a single swing of their blade.

name: Righteous Deliverance
description: Rumored to be forged from divine light, this polearm drives the darkness away and inspires those in its presence.

name: Righteous Spear of the Pure
description: A righteous weapon made manifest from the goodness of one's soul. So, if you've ever lied, shoplifted, or called someone a doofus, then the spear won't be nearly as powerful as they could have been.

name: Rimeblossom Revelry Spear (0 AC)
description: The spear's tip is a shard from a Rimeblossom Sidhe's wings. When a duel is settled, the defeated has their wings torn to pieces by their fellow Fae.

name: Rimeblossom Revelry Spear (AC)
description: The spear's tip is a shard from a Rimeblossom Sidhe's wings. When a duel is settled, the defeated has their wings torn to pieces by their fellow Fae.

name: Rip Tide
description: Beneath the power of this scythe your foes will fall like the breaking of waves.

name: Riparian Trident
description: Blessed by a mermaid sage, this trident harnesses its power from the Runes of Riparian. Every so often, an aquatic rune presents itself to its wielder.

name: Rising Incendo Spear
description: One of the many man-made weapons aimed to melt Lore's North and South Poles. If it makes it to the tip of the planet, veins of fire will empty the sea.

name: Roar of Chaos
description: The power of Chaos can be used in many different ways. The Chaotic WarMage uses it to boost their own personal power in battle.

name: Rocket on a Stick
description: Ooooohhh! Ahhhhhh! Click it and watch it fly!

name: Rod of All Potato
description: The rod of all potato is a reminder of all the potoes and potaters that secretly work underground.

name: Rotfinger's Hollowborn Scythe
description: Pieces of Rotfinger made their way to the Underworld, so the Hollowborn incorporated them into a set of weapons.

name: Rotfinger's Scythe
description: I'm not sure if this is Rotfinger's weapon… or a weapon made out of bits of Rotfinger. Ew.

name: Rouge Double Blades
description: You killed them, killed them all. They're dead, every single one of them. All of the enemies threatening your home. In the setting sunlight, the sands are tinted pink and gold with all their blood.

name: Royal Centurion Pike
description: Many serve Lascivia in her Hoard'em. This is the pike carried by those who serve as Royal Guards.

name: Royal Knight's Lance
description: The Royal Guard of Swordhaven swear only one vow: to protect the royal family with their swords, shields, and lives. It is an honor to serve Good.

name: Royal Nereidian Trident (0 AC)
description: Deep below the waves, an entire civilization flourishes. The Nereidian people rule a vast underwater realm, but one that has never been fully explored by humans.

name: Royal Nereidian Trident (AC)
description: Deep below the waves, an entire civilization flourishes. The Nereidian people rule a vast underwater realm, but one that has never been fully explored by humans.

name: Royal Summer Parasol Polearm
description: A favorite weapon for young Swordhaven royals on summer break from Skyguard Academy. (This item will return each year.)

name: Royal Winter Paladin's Sentinel
description: An honored icey spear, named Sentinel - Inspired by legends that tell of a weapon created from the finger tip of the Avatar Kyanos, created to protect one of his Champions.

name: Royalty Of SwordHaven
description: The people of Swordhaven trust and depend on your skill in battle to keep them safe.

name: Ruby Poleaxe
description: It may look too sparkly and pretty too take in battle, but this gem will knock you across the room!

name: Runehawk Scythe
description: A carefully crafted scythe pulsing with mana. Meant to slice through the fog that obscures ancient secrets and mysteries - including the fog that erased its namesake's existence.

name: Ryuja-jin Scythe
description: A three-bladed scythe wielded by the Nagavanshi, and named after the first Yokai their Empress created by stirring the waters of her realm. It is a weapon that cuts down her enemies, and blesses fields with plenty.

name: Sacred Forest Scythe
description: This scythe is a branch that was torn off of a Nature Dragon. So long as the original body is alive, they feel every life reaped by this scythe. It keeps their own deaths at bay.

name: Sacred Ryuja-jin Scythe
description: A three-bladed scythe wielded by the Nagavanshi, and named after the first Yokai their Empress created by stirring the waters of her realm. It is a weapon that cuts down her enemies, and blesses fields with plenty.

name: Sacrificial Siculi
description: An extremely durable bident that can channel spells of calamitous potential. They'd harm the caster, but the staff endures the kickback on its wielders behalf. To properly forge one, twins must be offered to the forge as sacrifices.

name: Sage Scythe of Revontheus
description: Found in the Underworld, this scythe gives the Revontheus the skills and deception needed to make the final strike against members of Dage's Legion.

name: Sakura Scythe
description: Do not let the beauty of the scythe fool you… the blades of these petals are sharper than the iciest wind, and cut as deeply.

name: Sanctolina Halberd
description: A golden ax that brings peace and serenity. It's an odd ability for a weapon, but it noticeably slows your opponents down. If you consider how it could be used in executions, the calm it brings to the condemned would be a sweet mercy.

name: Sand Spear Sickle
description: With this wicked weapon, you'll be able to sweep the sands clean of enemies by slicing through any opponents you encounter!

name: Sands Of Blood Scythe
description: Sanddemondude once saw a hieroglyphic of guards outside a royal chamber wielding a very strange scythe. Using the images as a base they crafted this scythe out of the recovered gems and gold found in the Sandsea.

name: SandSea Guardian's Polearm
description: The Sandsea Guardian is a member of the elite Oasis Defense Force. Their armor helms helps them blend in with the dunes, making attacking their enemies much easier.

name: Sandstorm Sceptre
description: A sceptor that calls upon the power of the storm. Though Pharaoh Djeba used it to protect his people, it has the destructive capability of summoning winds that can strip skin from bone.

name: Sapphire Knight's Dragon Lance
description: For when you want to pierce your enemies and look cool doing it.

name: Sapphire Knight's Lance
description: For when you want to pierce your enemies and look cool doing it.

name: Sapphire Poleaxe
description: It may look too sparkly and pretty too take in battle, but this gem will knock you across the room!

name: Sapphire Slayer's Spear
description: Made from a magically hardened icicle in honor of Seffy the Sapphire Slayer, this spear will chill your enemies to the bone… FOREVER!

name: Sapphire Slicer
description: Sapphire focuses healing energies and when ground up and placed in potions, can be very beneficial whe used by field medics. When used in weaponry, it makes you look REALLY stylish as you slash your foes!

name: Savagery Reaper
description: The scythe is engraved with runes that seal the wielder's true strength. If the weapon meets a neck it can't sever, it shatters. Absolute destruction is unleashed, claiming friends and foes.

name: Scallywag Pirate's Skewer (0 AC)
description: The vindication continues… even across the seven seas!

name: Scallywag Pirate's Skewer (AC)
description: The vindication continues… even across the seven seas!

name: Scalpula Debris Scythe
description: There were a number of extremities that had to be cut off of Creature 10. Re played around with the leftovers, and gave the Chimera what she called "utensils." She set them loose, and told them to go make their own lunch.

name: Scarsgarde Polearm
description: The last line of defense for Scarsgarde, they fight to protect the Keep!

name: Scavenged Infernal Spear
description: So you lost your weapon - well, don't despair! Grab bits of any Infernal items lying around and get your Blacksmith to craft a whole new weapon! Don't forget to attach the Swordhaven symbol and toss on some horns that you nabbed when you battled one of the Infernal Army, and voila! New weapon!

name: Scorching Orb Polearm
description: War-driven wraiths are given this monstrous spear at the expense of their servitude of Nulgath. If you are good, you are one of the lucky few to have stolen it and escaped without losing your sanity.

name: Scorpion Scythe
description: The tip of this scythe packs a paralyzing punch that could drop even the largest of gorillaphants.

name: Scorpion Spear
description: This weapon is made from left-over scorpion parts. It is resourceful and powerful!

name: Scroll Keeper's Spear
description: What's better to use to protect fragile books than a stabbity spear?

name: Scythe of Azalith
description: You can feel the dark power pulsing off this scythe. It is a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Scythe Of Blessings
description: Cleansing the world of evil never looked so beautiful.

name: Scythe of Broken Chains
description: This scythe is wrapped in the chains that once bounded us under the surface of Lore for so many years. The living take for granted the fact that they don't walk around in shackles. Let them know what it's like to be imprisoned!

name: Scythe of Carving
description: Pumpkins aren't the only things that are going to be carved up this Mogloween!

name: Scythe of Destiny
description: Unfortunately you realize that death is the only way to salvation. BRING IT ON DEATH!

name: Scythe of Dread
description: Do you have FEELINGS? Do you wish you could murder WITH those feelings? I got you covered.

name: Scythe of Eternal Retribution
description: By the power of blood, breath, and bone, these dark magic users seek the ultimate prize: immortality… and they do not care who they must hurt to achieve it.

name: Scythe of Gazeroth
description: Power and magic… Djinn Knights must possess both if they are to successfully guard the denizens of the Djinn Realm.

name: Scythe Of Gourds
description: When a pumpkin patch becomes its own bane, there's no reaping its pumpkins tonight or any autumn day. Don't worry, there's always room for alternatives….

name: Scythe of Guilt
description: The only guilt you'll feel is not taking out more ChaosWeavers.

name: Scythe of Holiday Horror (0 AC)
description: Brings bad luck to any who choose to wield it.

name: Scythe of Holiday Horror (AC)
description: Brings bad luck to any who choose to wield it.

name: Scythe of Insanity
description: Time to sever that membrane that went inside!

name: Scythe of Liberty
description: Infused with a burning spirit of liberty, this exceptional scythe was designed to rise beyond limitations, withstand injustices, and is ultimately the weapon for freedom.

name: Scythe of Maelstrom
description: Turmoil brought forth this scythe, makes you wonder where those skulls came from?

name: Scythe of Malignant Desire
description: A possessive entity grips this curved blade. It cuts and infects, causing mysterious veins to grow from the wounds. You shouldn't be using it, but you can hear whispered promises. Grow stronger. Together.

name: Scythe of Original Voids
description: Contracted by the devil, forged in the void, this scythe brings misery to all who come in contact with it. Designed by Deviled and the Original Voids crew. Color Custom.

name: Scythe of Recollection
description: A magical implement created by Archfiend Casimir that can pull memories to the surface. He didn't stop there. Knowledge would be ripped out of his victims' minds and stored away, never to be known again.

name: Scythe of Red Death
description: The Red Death brings darkness and decay where ever it goes.

name: Scythe of Revenant
description: A ghoulish weapon formed from the remains of Hollow Revenants. This scythe will have your enemies running scared… or whatever is left of them.

name: Scythe of Ruin
description: Once per century the Dark Druid of DoomWood can contact the plane of darkness and summon evil and corrupt weapons from that wicked dimension. This is one of that undead host.

name: Scythe of Salvation
description: The blade swings down on those who beg mercy, but is stayed for those who beg forgiveness.

name: Scythe of Scintillation
description: The magical lantern attached around the scythe's blade will guide you throughout life's adventures, from the darkest of time to the greatest moments. Give thanks to this scythe!

name: Scythe of Scourge
description: To you, a plague on this world is just like a nice and relaxing bubble bath.

name: Scythe of Screams (1)
description: With a hack hack here and a slash slash there…

name: Scythe of Screams (2)
description: Unlucky Pirates that cross into the underworld must leave behind all of their worldly possession. Now, you'll reap what they've lost.

name: Scythe of Shadows
description: Ever wondered what it would be like to serve Gravelyn and the ShadowScythe? Wonder no more! You're now a warrior and will spend an eternity serving.

name: Scythe of Sisyphean
description: A true masterpiece crafted by Great Gilead elders. The amount of tedious detail that went into this scythe cannot be ignored by any soul.

name: Scythe of Sorrow
description: For those who are only happy when it rains, only when it's complicated.

name: Scythe of the Blademaiden
description: Rodeleros once wielded swords, but traded them for bone scythes when she became Archfiend. Weightless yet deadly. They're perfect for her. Rodeleros' mentor made sure they would be. They're his bones, after all.

name: Scythe of the Celestial Guard (AC)
description: Celestial Guards must remain vigilant in times of struggle, this scythe helps balance their emotions to remain calm and clear.

name: Scythe of the Celestial Guard (Legend)
description: Celestial Guards must remain vigilant in times of struggle, this scythe helps balance their emotions to remain calm and clear.

name: Scythe of the Dark Chronomancer
description: On the edge of the Timevoid, waves of ephemeral shadows swirl out of an entrance to the Plane of Darkness. Only Chronomancers of Darkness possess the power to survive the combined might of elemental magic mixed with the temporal aether.

name: Scythe of the Dark Mage
description: Not all of Sora's weapons are hourglasses. This particular scythe has been handed down over generations to those who bare the name of Hoshi.

name: Scythe of the Decrepit
description: Your demise will be had if you dare to enter to Blackhorn Tomb. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED!

name: Scythe of the Fallen
description: You can feel the dark power pulsing off this scythe. It is a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Scythe of the First Sunbeam (AC)
description: A scythe forged in the image of the first bent ray of sunlight that shone on Lore, giving rise to a Golden Dragon. It's difficult to acertain whether this is the truth or not, but it's a lovely story nonetheless.

name: Scythe of the First Sunbeam (Non-AC)
description: A scythe forged in the image of the first bent ray of sunlight that shone on Lore, giving rise to a Golden Dragon. It's difficult to acertain whether this is the truth or not, but it's a lovely story nonetheless.

name: Scythe of the Garnet
description: A scythe whose blade has been carved from the precious Garnet stone. A timeless design for the new decade!

name: Scythe of the Legion
description: Cursed by Dage the Evil, this scythe takes the souls of every man, woman, child and creature that it touches and converts them into the newest members of Dage's Legion.

name: Scythe of the Old Kings
description: Gold and lapis lazuli were combined by the foremost smith in the SandSea to forge this spectacular scythe. Inlaid with precious turquoise gems on the blade, this weapon will ensure that you look your best while slaying the worst Lore has to throw at you!

name: Scythe Of The Void
description: An otherworldly weapon that defies the laws of nature and physics. A rip in space-time, revealing the Void, forms and the scythe's destructive blade.

name: Scythe of Vengeance
description: So…pretty.

name: Sea King's Trident
description: Yarrrr! Th' Sea King awards this Trident to mer warriors who defend the realm with honor and integrity… and meet the monthly quota of loot.

name: Seared Fireknight Polearm
description: Dipped in the fires of Embersea, the blade of this polearm blazes.

name: Seraphic Grave Digger Spade
description: Your tool of the your trade.

name: Serene Clarity Spear
description: An enchanted spear meant to permanently release great beasts from the thrall of the dark. Its purity purges all evil, and guides trapped souls to find peace.

name: Serpent Claw
description: This weapons is swift and deadly like a serpent.

name: Serpent Knight Polearm
description: These ornate weapons are only for the Serpent Knights.

name: Serpentis Imperator Spear
description: A pale gold serpent entwined with gold. A lost soul yearning for warmth. This spear is wielded by a divine royal who was cast into the dark, unwanted yet dutiful.

name: Seven Circles Primal Spear (0 AC)
description: An intricate, and near ornamental, spear created from materials found deep in the seven circles. The Beast gnawed on the bones of ancient ones, and Dage the Evil took them to forge this weapon.

name: Seven Circles Primal Spear (AC)
description: An intricate, and near ornamental, spear created from materials found deep in the seven circles. The Beast gnawed on the bones of ancient ones, and Dage the Evil took them to forge this weapon.

name: Shadow Beastmaster of Nulgath Spear
description: Nulgath's creatures aren't small, you will need something long and terrifying to keep them in line with.

name: Shadow Dragon's Defender Polearm (0 AC)
description: The Shadow Dragon thanks you for your valiant efforts defending its life!

name: Shadow Dragon's Defender Polearm (AC)
description: The Shadow Dragon thanks you for your valiant efforts defending its life!

name: Shadow Dragon's Defender Polearms (0 AC)
description: The Shadow Dragon thanks you for your valiant efforts defending its life!

name: Shadow Dragon's Defender Polearms (AC)
description: The Shadow Dragon thanks you for your valiant efforts defending its life!

name: Shadow Dragon's Rod
description: Call the darkness to protect the Shadow Dragons!

name: Shadow DragonMaster's Polearm
description: These beings are not infernals themselves, however they acquired the powers of infernals by consuming their souls and now use that power against them. They are not good, or evil… but one thing is certain - they are no ally of the infernal.

name: Shadow DragonMaster's Poleaxe
description: These beings are not Infernals themselves, however they acquired the powers of Infernals by consuming their souls and now use that power against them. They are not good, or evil… but one thing is certain - they are no ally of the Infernal.

name: Shadow Infinity Pike
description: The hour of your victory is upon us! 2016 is the year you shall ascend to mastery!

name: Shadow Jester Scythe
description: Aren't you just dying to use this scythe?

name: Shadow Legion Vampire Scythe
description: Brutal, remorseless, and cruel, Shadow Legion Vampires brandish this momumental scythe as a fair warning to anyone foolish enough to cross their path.

name: Shadow Ronin Naginata
description: Strike with the force of a thousand samurais and the quickness of the wind.

name: Shadow's Edge Polearm
description: If you are not born of the Shadows yourself, you must earn the right to control them by proving your might. Only ceaseless ambition can stand against the prideful light.

name: Shadow's Guard Polearm
description: Dark as night so when you attack your enemies will only see the soft glow of the blade before meeting their end.

name: Shadow Scythe
description: This scythe has the ability to obfuscate into the shadows and lie dormant till its victim is ready to meet its final DOOM!!!

name: Shadow Scythe of Revontheus
description: Found in the Underworld, this scythe lets the Revontheus move between shadows as they stalk their prey.

name: Shadow Serpent Scythe
description: This weapon was crafted from the Shadow Serpent you defeated.

name: Shadow Slash
description: The word Abyss implies emptiness. If only this were true. This was forged from unknown, inhuman hands deep in the darkness, and sent to you. For what, only you can decide.

name: Shadow Spear of Nulgath
description: A spear forged from the shadows of the underworld.

name: Shadow Spear Of The Archangel (0 AC)
description: A weapon of justice left behind by the Archangel Nulgath. He meant to pass it on to his student, but the spear was lost when he flew through a portal into another world.

name: Shadow Spear of the ArchAngel (AC)
description: A weapon of justice left behind by the Archangel Nulgath. He meant to pass it on to his student, but the spear was lost when he flew through a portal into another world.

name: Shadow Void Shogun Naginata
description: These warriors once served a ruthless emperor until the Archfiend destroyed him. Selling their souls to Nulgath they now serve a new master.

name: ShadowEater Lance
description: Stealing power from the very shadows surrounding them, the ShadowEaters are almost impossible to defeat.

name: Shadowed Beacon Polearm
description: This celestial polearm was crafted by Bido for Gjappy. It is a beacon of hope, and now they are sharing it with you!

name: Shadowed Nightmare's Spear (0 AC)
description: Deep in the shadows, the Queen's creatures stalk the realm. Waiting for the unwary to come closer… closer… before they strike.

name: Shadowed Nightmare's Spear (AC)
description: Deep in the shadows, the Queen's creatures stalk the realm. Waiting for the unwary to come closer… closer… before they strike.

name: Shadowed Polearm
description: Wield this against any foes you might encounter as you battle on behalf of Chaos!

name: Shadowed Sun Scythe
description: At a certain angle, the scythe brings to mind the image of a dragon of darkness. Perhaps in dark sunspots or during an eclipse, dragons do emerge on the Sun's surface.

name: Shadowfall Commander Spear
description: Empress Gravelyn has awarded you the title of Shadowfall Commander as a thank you for your loyalty and bravery!

name: ShadowFlame Battle Spear
description: Those who study the magics of the ShadowFlame slowly begin to become one with them.

name: ShadowFlame Defender's Spear
description: Good, Evil, or Chaos… the heroes of Lore have always followed leader whose nature is well-defined, and whose goals are clear. But for those who choose to serve Malgor, the leader of the ShadowFlame… a very dark fate awaits.

name: ShadowFlame Dragon Spear (AC)
description: Sometimes a DragonLord falls victim to the Shadow, no matter how hard they fight it. This is the result.

name: ShadowFlame Dragon Spear (Legend)
description: Sometimes a DragonLord falls victim to the Shadow, no matter how hard they fight it. This is the result.

name: ShadowFlame DragonMage Spear
description: Something wicked is definitely on its way when Shadowflame DragonMage's meet to summon powerful dragons.

name: ShadowFlame Eviscerator Scythe
description: The weapon gives a peek into the unforgiving cosmos. One day, the stars may become eyes that will scorn your power and prestiege.

name: ShadowFlame Fang Spear
description: These sacred spears were used to once promote peace but now they've been tarnished and now force innocent people from their homes.

name: ShadowFlame Glaive
description: Slash and slice through your enemies, cutting great swathes through Malgor's army.

name: ShadowFlame Great Harp
description: A harp wielded by bards dedicated to sing the praises of Vulvan, Great Spirit of the Ring of Fires… this instrument has not yet been fully tainted by the ShadowFlame's corruption.

name: Shadowflame Juggernaut Spear
description: Warriors of the Shadowflame army vow to follow Malgor, the ShadowFlame, into the darkness and through time and eternity. They await the ultimate victory… and their rewards.

name: Shadowflame's Executor
description: Wielded by the Retainers of Shadowflame, seeking to right the wrongs that blemish this world in brutal fashion. If left to their own devices, they will never stop finding reasons to draw blood.

name: Shadowflame Vanguard Spear
description: Otherworldly smoke and smoulder rises from its burning core. Once lit, Shadowflame never truly burns away.

name: ShadowFlame Warlock's Scythe
description: Those who study the magics of the ShadowFlame slowly begin to become one with them.

name: ShadowRender Scythe
description: The battle for control of the Underworld has awoken things previously not seen in Lore. The ShadowRenders appeared after Gravelyn used the Doomblade to break free of the shadows. From where, we are not sure…

name: ShadowRipper Scythe
description: The battle for control of the Underworld has awoken things previously not seen in Lore. The ShadowRippers appeared after Gravelyn used the Doomblade to break free of the shadows. From where, we are not sure…

name: ShadowScythe of Doom
description: You like DOOM? I heard you like DOOM. Get your maximum DOOOOOM with the DoomLord, and LONG UN-LIVE THE SHADOWSCYTHE! Warning: Contains DOOM

name: ShadowScythe of Scourge
description: You don't have time for a bubble bath. Just turn on the shower!

name: Shadowscythe Rider Lance
description: Every mounted warrior needs a lance to poke, prod and stab people with.

name: ShadowScythe Seer's First Glaive
description: The ShadowScythe Seer uses their powers only for evil, to ensure that Gravelyn's Empire remains unbroken.

name: ShadowScythe Seer's Halberd
description: The ShadowScythe Seer uses their powers only for evil, to ensure that Gravelyn's Empire remains unbroken.

name: ShadowScythe Seer's Scythe
description: The ShadowScythe Seer uses their powers only for evil, to ensure that Gravelyn's Empire remains unbroken.

name: ShadowScythe Seer's Second Glaive
description: The ShadowScythe Seer uses their powers only for evil, to ensure that Gravelyn's Empire remains unbroken.

name: ShadowScythe Seer's Spear
description: The ShadowScythe Seer uses their powers only for evil, to ensure that Gravelyn's Empire remains unbroken.

name: Shadowslayer Relic Spear
description: The contents of this weapon are obscured by a tightly bound material that refuses to be undone. The mystery within is captivating. When will it be revealed?

name: ShadowStealer Ripper Scythe
description: Helpful for sneaking through the shadows in Ebonslate.

name: Shadowstrike Klesha (0 AC)
description: A physical manifestation of fear, forged in Darkness and tempered with ice. A wound from this weapon won't just make your enemies bleed. Their minds will be infected, poisoned by your terror.

name: Shadowstrike Klesha (AC)
description: A physical manifestation of fear, forged in Darkness and tempered with ice. A wound from this weapon won't just make your enemies bleed. Their minds will be infected, poisoned by your terror.

name: ShadowZard Lance (AC)
description: Protect Shadowfall and the Empress as you ride into battle.

name: ShadowZard Lance (Special)
description: Protect Shadowfall and the Empress as you ride into battle.

name: Shamrockin' Scythe
description: All your heavy (golden) metal needs in one rockin' scythe! /airguitar Happy Lucky Day!

name: Sharpened Bamboo
description: Never underestimate the power of a sharpened bamboo pole in the hands of a trained warrior.

name: Shattered Ice
description: This is one coooooool scythe! Inspired by xHAKOx suggestion and art done by Pinwheel.

name: Shattered Soul Harvester
description: Darkness ebbs and flows with battle, threatening to take over your resolve at the moment you weaken. Beware any shows of weakness, or you may be victim to your own darkness, kissing your soul goodbye.

name: Sheathed Soulfire Spear
description: Dage the Evil's SoulForge requires constant sacrifice and labor to keep its flames bright. The unworthy become fuel for the forge, while the fire of victory burns in the hearts of those called to serve the Legion.

name: Sheer Polearm
description: Cut your opponents with this spear… and if it shatters cut'em with the shards!

name: Sheng Chi Slasher
description: Hacking off enemy limbs with this blade is a win win, blocking both chi and blood flow!

name: Sheng Long Slasher
description: Warriors of the imperial Dynasty served their lords with unwavering loyalty. Thus gifted with a formidable weapon.

name: Shiden Bardiche
description: As deadly as it is precious (stone), The Shiden is named for the unique crystal at the top of the pole—literally meaning "purple lightning"

name: Shining Polearm
description: Wield this against any foes you might encounter as you battle on behalf of Chaos!

name: Shining Spear of Undead Slaying +15
description: Stick it to those undead. Released in honor of Artix Entertainment's new mobile game "Undead Assault"

name: Shinobi Naginata
description: When you're a Shinobi, nothing is out of your reach--especially when you wield wielding the Naginata! This Akiba Polearm has been passed down from generations of skilled Ninja.

name: Shu Ninja Naginata
description: It is the Year of the Rat, and these colorful Ninja are celebrating!

name: Sickle of the Eternal Dragon Warrior
description: Because sometimes one blade just isn't enough!

name: Sickle of the Harvest
description: Harvest your harvest in half the time with this autumn sickle!

name: Silly Karrot Bo
description: Sometimes life is too uncertain to have regrets. That's why ordinary people depend on heroes like you. (Click to extend to full size)

name: Silver Carteret Spear
description: A blacksmith from Mythsong was comissioned to forge this spear. In battle, it pleasantly chimes every time it clashes with steel. In fact, it's so pleasant that it motivates the wielder to find more reasons to fight.

name: Silver Ehangwen
description: A common but effective halberd owned by many Knights serving Swordhaven's noble court. It was named after the architect that designed the newer barracks in the capital city.

name: Silver Exalted Paladin Poleaxe
description: Unfortunately, Trolle'din died when a foe told him his shoelace was untied. Down he looked, to double-check, and his enemy took off his head - at the neck!

name: Silver Exalted Paladin Spear
description: Unfortunately, Trolle'din died when a foe told him his shoelace was untied. Down he looked, to double-check, and his enemy took off his head - at the neck!

name: Silver Overclocked Polearm
description: A strange voice whispers in your head as you pick this up… Tempora mutantur et nos mutamur in illis.

name: Silver Polearm
description: Great for stabbing… AND poking!

name: Silver Scythe in Shadow
description: In Lore, a scythe is a symbol of Death yet this weapon also captures the precious shine of life. The Moonborn can not exist for long, so they seek to carve proof that they were alive into history, the memories of their comrades, and scar those that threaten both.

name: Silver Skye Halberd
description: A weapon meant to be inherited, and passed from one generation to the next, in an unbroken line back to the first warriors of Skye. The steel has been burned by fiery dragon's breath, enchanting it with strength.

name: Silver Stonescythe
description: Only the most skilled and knowledgeable of the DragonMaster's have this weapon.

name: SilverStag Warrior's Lance (0 AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: SilverStag Warrior's Lance (AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: Simple Poleaxe
description: Looks pretty basic in terms of craftsmanship.

name: Skade's Snowpiercer
description: The Dracolich known as Skade is one of the many wonders of the Northlands. Pieces of his bones break off as he wanders, and are scavenged to forge weapons. They freeze your foes on contact, and shatter them into flakes of snow.

name: Skade's Snowsaga
description: The Dracolich known as Skade is one of the many wonders of the Northlands. Pieces of his bones break off as he wanders, and are scavenged to forge weapons. They freeze your foes on contact, and shatter them into flakes of snow.

name: Skade's Winged Snowpiercer
description: The Dracolich known as Skade is one of the many wonders of the Northlands. Pieces of his bones break off as he wanders, and are scavenged to forge weapons. They freeze your foes on contact, and shatter them into flakes of snow.

name: Skade's Winged Snowsaga
description: The Dracolich known as Skade is one of the many wonders of the Northlands. Pieces of his bones break off as he wanders, and are scavenged to forge weapons. They freeze your foes on contact, and shatter them into flakes of snow.

name: Skull Halberd
description: MORE SKULLS!

name: Skull of Casualties
description: When the sky burns and all the demons arise from Lore, there will be a force to reckon with and you will become just another casualty.

name: Skullbreaker's Spear
description: YOU ARE A SKULLBREAKER KNIGHT, TRAINED BY PALADINSLAYER VORDRED. IT TOOK MUCH SKILL AND MANY BROKEN SKULLS TO GAIN HIS APPROVAL. NOW GO BREAK MORE. MORE SKULLS.

name: Skullpiercer Trident
description: Like a vengeful god of the sees, Naval Commander Vordred wields his trident with great impunity. He'd rip skull after skull from their bodies, and have to wade through the water to retrieve his weapon whenever he threw it.

name: Skyguard Halberd
description: When engaging in aerial combat, the Skyguard arm themselves with long, versatile weapons known as Halberds. It is an honor to see such craftsmanship let alone wield it.

name: Skyguard Spear
description: These bladed spears are great when you need to board an enemy ship and really want to make an impact on your opponents while staying comfortable out of reach.

name: Skyscorcher
description: The intricate blade of this polearm was once able call forth an energy storm that is enhanced by stats. Quibble tells you it may have lost the ability to make energy storms… maybe.

name: Slash
description: Skulls have been worked into the blood red iron of this Horc weapon.

name: Slayer Recruit's DragonSpear
description: Hate dragons? Did one burn down your house? Does the name Targaryan cause rage? Then you've joined the right squad!

name: Slayer's Legacy
description: Warmly Tip: Defeat beast, take for armor.  Best use!

name: Slimed DragonMaster Scythe
description: Make sure to wash your hands after using this weapon.

name: Sol Vicarius
description: There will come a day when the sun sets for the very last time. Emissary Astero knows it to be so, and we must prepare. When the end comes, the Light will embrace all.

name: Solar Dragon Spear
description: A golden spear graciously donated to the Skyguard by a curious Dragon, in exchange for quicky entry and a high rank. The new recruit was scolded, but allowed entry after accomplishing the same tests everyone else took.

name: Solar Lorekeeper Spear
description: Even a Lorekeeper has to ready for a fight. Have you seen the size of the Sneevils that hang out behind the library?

name: Solar Star Polearm
description: A special type of starsword given to agile Star Captains and Upholders, it is something specialy made to keep thieves and unseen enemies from ambushing you. If they are spun in a 360 degree angle, it can also make a decent shield. Don't try this at home or anything near flammable.

name: Solar Star Scythe
description: Use this scythe with care because mental strength is needed to properly control its power.

name: Solidified Lightning Staff
description: Wield solidified lightning to slay your opponents!

name: Soul Gouging Spear
description: If you're touch by this, the Unholiness have your soul.

name: Soul Harvester Spear
description: This spear was crafted by Death to kill the living immortals and collect their souls. Note: This spear transforms while in combat.

name: Soul Jacker of Nulgath
description: (Item does 40% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)Nulgath presents you one of the most dangerous scythes used for necromancy… due to multiple complications, Nulgath banned his soldiers from using it in the war from 2012…

name: Soul Ripper Scythe
description: Problem: So many creatures refuse to hand over their souls.

name: Soul Saving Spear
description: Used to retrieve souls taken by unholy means.

name: Soul Scythe
description: The scythe of Soulseeker is now yours.

name: Soul Spear
description: Skewer your opponents and count coup.

name: Soul Stealer Scythe
description: Hey, the scythe is the perfect weapon to use when reaping souls of the innocent… or guilty ones. Whatever's more convenient.

name: Soul Weaver's Scythe (0 AC)
description: Souls wander through out the Underworld. Only the most skilled can channel the power that remains, using them for arcane spells and magic.

name: Soul Weaver's Scythe (AC)
description: Souls wander through out the Underworld. Only the most skilled can channel the power that remains, using them for arcane spells and magic.

name: SoulBinder Poleaxe
description: This weapon aids in the binding of souls, drawing them from the void - a window to whitch is visible within its head.

name: Soulcursed Silencer
description: Bido created these weapons when experimenting with different materials. He's personally fond of his own weapons so he offered these to you.

name: SoulEater Scythe
description: A scythe with an unknown master. When even the undead overstay their welcome, they must be reaped. Perhaps, this heavy blade awaits worthy hands, cold enough to embody the finality of Death.

name: Soulreaper of Nulgath
description: Nulgath takes your signed contract in exchange for the "SoulReaper of Nulgath." You're excited, yet uneasy, as Nulgath goes on to say, "Enjoy! As it states in the contract you signed, you can owe me later for this."

name: South Sea Queen's Trident
description: These golden tridents have been wielded by the warriors of Wentira, the golden city, for centuries as they pay homage to Nyai Rara Kidul, the Queen of the Southern Sea. It is both an honor and a responsibility for chosen warriors. (Click gem to transform)

name: SPACE STABBER!
description: Show space who is the REAL boss!

name: Spear of 100 Bodies
description: I took a spear to the patella!

name: Spear Of Ardor
description: Victory is fleeting. It is the journey leading up to it that the bards will sing of for generations.

name: Spear of Awe (0 AC)
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Spear of Awe! (AC)
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Spear of Darkness
description: Stained by blood, a mighty spear has been tainted to resemble a silent scream if it were seen. Like the fallen, the chains bind the locked souls to an eternal suffering.

name: Spear of Dionaea
description: A bloodthirsty monster sought Dzeza in order gain its power. Their desire to conquer, spill blood, and spread hatred - it all disappeared. Now, it must grow. It will do nothing but grow. The reason it exists is to grow.

name: Spear of Divine Grace
description: ﻿The bright power emanating from this spear soothes your spirit and renews your flagging energy. It is a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Spear of Doom Reborn
description: This lance rose from the shade of the eclipse. It calls for a new partner with a desire for vengeance as dark as its own. Chained to your hands, it becomes an extension of your will…or rather, "our" will.

name: Spear of Dragon's Vengeance
description: Pierce the heav… oh wait. Dragons!

name: Spear of Duality (0 AC)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power for Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: Spear of Duality (AC)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power for Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: Spear of Embers
description: This spear crafted by one of Pyralis' pyromancers out of super-heated lavarock.

name: Spear of Guiding
description: The AQW Ambassadors thank you for playing AQWorlds. This weapon is a gift from them to wish you good luck in your adventures!

name: Spear of Honor
description: Awarded for decades of service to the Order of LightCasters, the Spear of Honor is a sign of gratitude.

name: Spear of Immortality
description: Everyone shall remember General Lionfang's name and all of the great deeds that he stands for!

name: Spear Of Legend
description: The Spear of Legend is waiting for you, Hero, to write the next chapter of its legacy.

name: Spear Of Life +5
description: The glows comes from all the lives saved. (Polearm gives 5% more gold when equipped!)

name: Spear of Light
description: Long ago, a mighty Paladin reached up towards the sky and took hold of a beam of sunlight. Channeling his energies, he solidified the sunbeam and forged it into this imposing polearm.

name: Spear of Lost Jewels
description: Diamonds and gold, lost at sea and tainted by drowned souls. This spear will set you for life, if you survive its curse.

name: Spear of Malevolence (0 AC)
description: Equipping this ancient, magically-crafted artifact will ensure that you will be fueled in battle by a malevolent fury strong enough to last beyond death.

name: Spear of Malevolence (AC)
description: Equipping this ancient, magically-crafted artifact will ensure that you will be fueled in battle by a malevolent fury strong enough to last beyond death.

name: Spear of Malice
description: Infused with the hatred for the dead, this spear slices through flesh like a knife through a warm stick of butter.

name: Spear of Nulgath
description: One can feel the pulse of energy that travels through this fearsome spear.

name: Spear of Risidual Truth
description: Slowly, the world fills with lies. When the land can no longer stand the weight of these lies, take this spear and destroy all that hides the truth… in the name of the one who lost their way, so deep inside the Underworld.

name: Spear of the Archangel (0 AC)
description: A weapon of justice left behind by the Archangel Nulgath. He meant to pass it on to his student, but the spear was lost when he flew through a portal into another world.

name: Spear of the Archangel (AC)
description: A weapon of justice left behind by the Archangel Nulgath. He meant to pass it on to his student, but the spear was lost when he flew through a portal into another world.

name: Spear of the Archfiend
description: Crafted by fiendish weaponsmiths chained to infernal forges, this spear was crafted in honor of Nulgath the ArchFiend. Only the strongest members of his Nation are worthy of wielding it.

name: Spear of the Dawn
description: Spears of the Dawn are wielded by the Guardians of the Dawn which protect the might City of the Dawn. They were invented by a potato and blessed by Gjappy with blessings of hope.

name: Spear of the Deep One
description: It's a good idea to keep a trident handy in case you swim across any other Deep Ones.

name: Spear of the Depths
description: From out of the depths, a terror rises: a ghostly hand grasps this spear aimed directly at your heart. Do not fear… it is a gift from Neso, the Water Avatar, to aid you in battle.

name: Spear of the Fallen
description: Stained by blood, a mighty spear has been tainted to resemble a silent scream as if it were seen. Like the fallen, the chains bind the locked souls to an eternal suffering.

name: Spear of the Lone Hunter
description: Created from the bones of a worthy foe, the spear pierces through ice, thick hide, and scales. It was created in a restless world of hunters and hunted.

name: Spear of the New Year
description: We wish you a Yeti New Year!

name: Spear of the Oracle
description: The ability to see fate before it culminates is balanced out by the deaf ears of those who need to hear the truth the most. Pierce through the veil of lies.

name: Spear of the Southern Sea
description: Forged in gold and jade, this trident-like weapon embodies Nyi Roro Kidul's dominion. Strike with the fury of waves and the certainty of destiny.

name: Spear of the Undying
description: In the days that Vincenzo and Brutus were amongst the living, Brutus gifted Vincenzo a gilded spear after their epic triumph over a wicked viking; a symbol of their undying bond.

name: Spear of Virtue
description: Only the true and holy ones will be able to unleash the ultimate power thats contained in this magical spear.

name: Spear of Wolf Slaying
description: Pay homage to the lord of the Northlands Warriors. He is the Spear Shaker, the Shield Breaker, and all who do battle honor him in this life… and (if they are worthy) in the next.

name: Spectral Dragonlord Spear
description: Crafted to honor dragons and to protect them. The spear fell just out of reach its previous owner was ambushed and placed in chains.

name: Spectral Lycan's Spear
description: Even the soul of an underhanded coward can take on the form of a relentless beast if steeped in enough curses and anguish. Death becomes a new beginning.

name: Spectrum Halberd
description: An enormous quantity of light bent into the form of a halberd. With an edge as thin as the visible spectrum, this blade is just plain sharp.

name: SpellCaster's Bright Scythe
description: Casters aide the Legion by summoning power and keeping the minions energized during battles.

name: SpellRaiser Polearm
description: To summon: Open the strange little box left sitting in the Underworld. Nothing bad could possibly come from it…

name: Spider Scythe
description: The itsy bitsy spider grew to ten feet tall, down came the rain and made the spider fall, rage filled its eyes and he headed for the plains… and you can just imagine what he did then.

name: Spiderkin Star Polearm
description: This specially crafted Star Polearm were designed and built for AQW's 10th Upholders on the game's tenth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Spiderkin Star Scythe
description: This specially crafted Star Scythe were designed and built for AQW's 10th Upholders on the game's tenth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Spine Spear
description: That's some backbone you've got! No one will call you "spineless" ever again. This is a Mogloween Seasonal Rare!

name: Spirit Harvester's Scythe
description: It's the time of year when all things are harvested… including spirits!

name: Spirit Hunter Scythe
description: Did you know spiritual energy could be weaponized? Oh yeah.

name: Spirit Scythe of Wrath
description: These Mysterious SpiritHunters are rumored to be sent from the depths of Bludrut Keep to purge the land of evil entities and to safeguard against supernatural forces that threaten the realm. Even the Shadowscythe fear to travel near Bludrut Keep.

name: SpiritHunter Halberd
description: Veddrian's weapon of choice when she's got a lot of room to swing her attacks.

name: SpiritHunter's Pike
description: That bitter chill you feel is NOT coming from the frigid Northlands wind… it's the icy aura of the invisible spirits surrounding you. Watching… waiting… Will they strike first? Or will you?

name: SpiritHunter's Reaper
description: Slice through spirits intent on possessing you! Drive out unwanted ghosts as you search for those you once knew.

name: Staff of Crimson Wind
description: Raise the staff to the night sky, and the wind will carry the gift of eternal night to all mortals. Seeing as the vampire population took a hit recently, the Queen will surely be pleased.

name: Staff of Despair
description: Your skill will become obsolete when dealing with the foul creatures that dwell in the Blackhorn Tomb.

name: Staff of the Scorpion
description: This magical staff is used by the Priests of the Scorpion. Used for conjuring dark spells, the priests also wield this staff when in direct combat.

name: Stained Glass Faerie's Scythe
description: Blue and purple, gold and green,

name: Starbane Lance
description: Forged from a meteor and cooled in the depths of Darkness, this lance accompanied a storied warrior. This individual was chosen at birth, born on the day a star fell on a lightless night.

name: SteamCutter
description: Manufactured by Kamikampi, this gas-powered rotating blade works best when killing foes and getting at those hard to reach weeds in your garden!

name: Stella Auriga Scythe
description: Forged from fallen stardust, the scythe's origins can be traced to a blade immortalized by the cosmos. It is a beautiful and desperate creation, meant to sever lamentable strings of fate.

name: Stella Empyrean Spear
description: A solar storm cascades over the universe's infinite stars. Their light solidifies into a spear that falls from the heavens, searching for a worthy sovereign, or kingmaker.

name: Sterling Dragonknight Scythe
description: An elaborate weapon that rarely sees battle. Outside of scythes being difficult to wield by amateurs, they're known to be used by a spiteful knight who slays the partners of Dragonlords out of jealousy.

name: Sterling Drake Halberd
description: A weapon typically used by aspiring Dragonlords who protect the nests and castle forts. They house the Dragon eggs of the trainees' seniors.

name: SternLord's Aurum Spear (0 AC)
description: The teachings of the ArchAngel Nulgath warn that the good can commit evil deeds. His students must be prepared to fight one of their own if they take justice too far.

name: SternLord's Aurum Spear (AC)
description: The teachings of the ArchAngel Nulgath warn that the good can commit evil deeds. His students must be prepared to fight one of their own if they take justice too far.

name: Stolen CA Scythe
description: This scythe is property of the Crystallis administration. Return to Suite 37a1C, c/o Chief Munitions Coordinator.

name: Stolen CA Spear
description: This spear is property of the Crystallis administration. Return to Suite 37a1C, c/o Chief Munitions Coordinator.

name: Stone Minotiger Spear
description: Cindewclaw's spear is only won by the mightiest warriors.

name: Stone's Glow
description: This double-bladed scythe glows with an earthly radiance that screams destruction. Strength, migh and resolve flow from blade to user, enabling him or her to take on a multitude with confidence.

name: Storm Drakel's Prod
description: Like most Drakel weapons, this prod runs on currents and energy.

name: Storm Rebel Lance
description: A lance wielded by Elven royalty was claimed by the ice and storms. It strikes faster than lightning, and splits the earth like a divine knife.

name: Stormbringer Halberd
description: Gold is an excellent conductor of energy and lightning. The Stormbringers, and those who venerate the winds and the cracks in the sky adorm themselves as well as their weappons with the precious metal.

name: Stormslasher Stick
description: Anytime these combat-made, heat-resistant hockey sticks light up, it is a strong indicator that this match is not a game anymore; it is a fight for survival.

name: Stormy Pinkness
description: The things we cherish are small indeed, so much the larger weapons that we need! The Stormy Pinkness is the monster's weakness, bringing doom and gloom this afternoon!

name: Strong Scythe of Gazeroth
description: Power and magic… Djinn Knights must possess both if they are to successfully guard the denizens of the Djinn Realm.

name: Sugar Plum Gift Scythe
description: Give the gift of a swift death to your foes.

name: Sugary Scythe of Slaying
description: Best be careful, this is one sharp candy cane!

name: Summoner of Storms
description: Legends speak of a great sky dragon who blessed an ancient halberd with his mighty power.

name: Sunblaze Scythe
description: The blade of the scythe is the fang of a power-hungry dragon. It wanted to tear open the planet and set it ablaze to create a new Sun. Its lingering wish calls to you.

name: Super Kathool Spear
description: Hopefully your disguise will fool any Deep Ones you run across, but it's a good idea to keep a trident handy just in case.

name: Supercharged Heavenly Hasher
description: Harness the power of light to continue the fight against Ebil! Don't give up, Hero! Damage range of 30 to really hit EbilCorp HARD! Battle On!

name: Superior Guard Spear
description: This spear is crafted with exceptional quality.

name: Supreme Dragon Scythe
description: A scythe crafted in tribute to the supreme dragons of Lore. A design completely created by player Skyline.

name: Surge Disruptor Scythe
description: This weapon was developed for the express purpose of sending the enemy, their lands, and their people back to the dark ages. It might as well be a death sentence.

name: Surtara Nagamaki
description: This massive blade mounted on a pole originates from the distant Yokai Isles. It gracefully sweeps across the battlefield, dancing like the wings of a crane.

name: Sutoku's Hollow Vengeance
description: A spear adorned with the golden skulls of a human and an Oni. Forged by bloodthirsty Yokai, they named if after the vengeful kami of the Oni. Born human, betrayed by humans. Slayer of Oni, and worshipped by them. Yokai are enamored by such contradictions.

name: Sutoku's Vengeance
description: A spear adorned with the golden skulls of a human and an Oni. Forged by bloodthirsty Yokai, they named if after the vengeful kami of the Oni. Born human, betrayed by humans. Slayer of Oni, and worshipped by them. Yokai are enamored by such contradictions.

name: SwarmTrooper Stick
description: Anytime these combat-made, heat-resistant hockey sticks light up, it is a strong indicator that this match is not a game anymore; it is a fight for survival.

name: Sweet Scythe of Pain
description: Spread a little holiday cheer with this scythe. The cheerful colors will brighten the scene while everyone around you swears the air seems to be a bit minty. Perhaps your enemy will appreciate the celebratory fashion is its death!

name: Sweet Spring Mage's Polearm
description: Your magic is fueled by the scent of spring flowers, gentle rains, and the strains of sweet songs drifting through sunlit groves.

name: Taco on a Stick
description: Pitchforks… useful for bailing hay or handing a crunchy taco up to a giant!

name: Tanabata Polearm
description: A Polearm for Yokai's Star Festival!

name: Techno Armored Spear (Legend)
description: A spear forged from the shadows of the underworld.

name: Techno Armored Spear (Non-Legend)
description: *No description*

name: Techno Dragon Spear (Legend)
description: The Golden Dragon has been passed down from generation to generation, between dragon slayers, after the first ever dragon fall that the point of its blade. Rumor says that the blade harnessed the power from that dragon which gives the spear its golden hue.

name: Techno Dragon Spear (Non-Legend)
description: *No description*

name: Techno Dragon Tongue Scythe (0 AC)
description: (Color Custom) An ancient scythe created in the image of a legendary dragon not from this plane of existence. Even Death recognizes the scythe's otherworldly properties.

name: Techno Dragon Tongue Scythe (AC)
description: (Color Custom) An ancient scythe created in the image of a legendary dragon not from this plane of existence. Even Death recognizes the scythe's otherworldly properties.

name: Techno Spear of Nulgath
description: A spear forged from the shadows of the underworld, then stabbed into the heart of the Matrix itself. (This weapon is not color customizable.)

name: Temporal Agent Decypher
description: Temporal Agents are the bane of those who would taint the fabric of our universe. They patrol the timestream, destroying any who would manipulate it for their own selfish ends.

name: Terror of Enyo
description: A lance that sunders civilization, bringing eras to their end. Though it's coveted by the Horsemen of the Undead Apocalypse, Dage The Evil intends to give it to a divine god of the end.

name: Thawsprout Staff
description: Formed from the first sprouts of spring, this staff nurtures new life. If you fall asleep with it in your arms, you'll wake up under a blanket of vines and moss.

name: The Apprentice's Scythe
description: Thou shall reap only thy souls of the recently dead!

name: The Brutalizer (AC)
description: Brutalize your opponents… and ensure your victory!

name: The Brutalizer (Legend)
description: Brutalize your opponents… and ensure your victory!

name: The Eggsterminator Scythe
description: Poach your enemies! Scramble the competition! With the Eggsterminator Scythe, all battles with be over-easy!

name: The Everglaive
description: Mudluk strive to protect the everglade swamps. Protect and defend what's most important to you with The Everglaive!

name: The Grave Spade
description: First you beat them down, then you BURY them!

name: The Hollow Spear
description: A haunting spear that *appears* to have no blade, once belonging to a fallen Hollowsoul Knight.

name: The Lance of The Legion
description: I wouldn't touch Nulgath even with this ten foot pole.

name: The Last Bellringer's Scythe
description: Scythes have always fascinated the spirits and Fae of the fall forests. They approach farmers to cause mischief, but there's always a chance that the hand on the scythe belongs to the Last Bellringer.

name: The Ogre's Spear
description: The spear used by the Coliseum's Champion Bestiarius, The Ogre. Maybe once you've won a few more matches, he'll let you add all of his trophy embellishments.

name: The Pain Scythe
description: It's body is rigid with rigor mortis, its mouth hangs open in a silent scream. Sometimes, though… sometimes you think you can hear it laughing.

name: The Plague Scythe
description: A lethal weapon filled with an equally lethal virus. Every slash of the weapon spreads a disease to your enemies. They're gonna need a lot more than Chickencow Soup to feel better after this one.

name: The Reaper's Scythe
description: Time isn't always on your side but with this you just might be able to bend it a bit.

name: The Rixty Ripper
description: The rare Rixty Ripper was awarded to those who upgraded their accounts via Rixty, featuring a color custom accessory glow and amazing detail. Rixty rocks!

name: The Rose's Engraved Polearm
description: You are Lore's Hero, and the safety of all our universes and timelines depend up YOU. Fight for evil, and defend our worlds from those that would harn it.

name: The Rot
description: Jagged and vicious. Don't even get me started on the smell.

name: The Scythe of Awe
description: This scythe will lead you to the road of glory!

name: The Scythe of Emptiness
description: Those touched by this cursed scythe will be lost forever, trapped inside their own minds only with empty thoughts.

name: The Scythe of Eternal Rest
description: The eradication of your foes will lead to just another set of bones in your ever growing collection.

name: Thermax's Scythe
description: The scythe of Thermax is now yours.

name: Three Worlds Scythe
description: This scythe was the result of three different cultures coming together. Elves, Dwarves and Mukluks each contributes materias materials and methods do its creation.

name: Thunderborn Trident
description: You'd think that combining lightning and water would be dangerous. Not for the Thunderborn!

name: Thyllian Domination Spear
description: Massive beasts fight for dominance in the churning sea. Yet a single tusk pointed at just the right angle can pierce right through their skull, and bring them peace. The Adeptus that grew this spear out of their body will feast on the spoils for months to come. (Does 30% more damage to all monsters)

name: TideWalker's Wrapped Spear (AC)
description: Nulgath not only holds dominion over the land, but also the sea. These TideWalkers sow dissent in order to promote Nulgath's Nation.

name: TideWalker's Wrapped Spear (Legend)
description: Nulgath not only holds dominion over the land, but also the sea. These TideWalkers sow dissent in order to promote Nulgath's Nation.

name: TideWalker's Wrapped Trident (AC)
description: Nulgath not only holds dominion over the land, but also the sea. These TideWalkers sow dissent in order to promote Nulgath's Nation.

name: TideWalker's Wrapped Trident (Legend)
description: Nulgath not only holds dominion over the land, but also the sea. These TideWalkers sow dissent in order to promote Nulgath's Nation.

name: Tiki Torch
description: Light up the night with your torch!

name: Time of Dying Scythe
description: Are you dead? Are you alive? Are you some kind of amalgam of the two?

name: Time Reaper Scythe
description: "Death is but a door, Time is but a window. I'll be back - Dr. Raymond Stantz."

name: TimeDragon's Defender Polearm
description: The time dragon thanks you for your valiant efforts defending its life!

name: TimeKeeper Scythe
description: On the battlefield, you give a new meaning to killing time. What time is it? Killing Time! When is it? Always!

name: TimeReaper Scythe
description: Where Drakath goes the TimeReapers follow. Have to help keep the timelines clean!

name: Timewalker's Ripper
description: For 13 years, you have battled through AdventureQuest Worlds, a merge of 3 different timelines. You've traveled lightyears already, but our adventures together are far from over!

name: Tinsel Taunter
description: Don't let the tinsel fool you. Wield this weapon for maximum holiday retribution. Shiny and deadly, this may be the best way to dress up the holiday cheer this season.

name: Titanium FrostElf Lance
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This battle gear is worn during challenges to take the throne.

name: Tonbo Giri
description: This ultimate spear of the wind has been recreated from samples obtained the cloud city at the end of the Bridge to the Sky in AdventureQuest.

name: Toxic Alchemist's Noxious Lance
description: A subset of the Toxic Alchemists are known to dwell in Greenguard Forest. They crafted this venomous lance for the rogues there from the reagents they harvested.

name: Toxic Alchemist's Venom Lance
description: A subset of the Toxic Alchemists are known to dwell in Greenguard Forest. They crafted this noxious lance for the rogues there from the reagents they harvested.

name: Toxic Diviner Spear
description: Bido's loyal Diviners don these robes for they are the warlocks who protect the strange relics that Bido has stashed away.

name: Toxic Knight's Polearm
description: While wandering through Lore, Bido came across a set of knights that had besome corrupted by a horrible toxin. Needles to say, he just had to grab their gear!

name: Toxic Plague Spear
description: Just radiating with power.

name: Toxic Revenger Polearm
description: Slice and skewer your opponents, then infect them with a noxious poison. This polearm will return in the future, but is only available during a "random prize drawings" during Friday night releases.

name: Toxic Scythe
description: The bright colors of this emerald scythe are as deceptive as the swamp itself. Don't touch that blade!

name: Toxic Wisteria's Reach
description: You have scavenged parts from the Toxic Wisteria to make your own Toxic Polearm!

name: Toy Pitchfork
description: Someone devilishly swapped someone's real weapon with a toy, which led to predictable results. You've got sharper skills. This'll be a threat in your hands.

name: Transforming Berzerker Bunny Spear
description: You notice a strange button on the polearm. When you push it, the weapon transforms itself into another style of weapon right before your eyes!

name: Translucent Axe
description: Cut your opponents with this spear… and if it shatters cut'em with the shards!

name: Tribal SkinWalker's Poleaxe
description: With the ability to turn into any animal at all, SkinWalkers have been around for thousands of years, lurking in the shadows of the forest.

name: Tribal SkinWalker's Spear
description: With the ability to turn into any animal at all, SkinWalkers have been around for thousands of years, lurking in the shadows of the forest.

name: Trident of Alignment
description: When all hope seems to be lost, the Trident of Alignment is there to guide you and help your restore balance.

name: Trident of Chaos
description: By Land or By Sea, Chaos will be there waiting for you! All hope is gone..

name: Ultimate Evil Scythe

The spear represents the encouragement to not be afraid to go outside the boundary that confines you.

description: A harp wielded by the Embersea Bards dedicated to sing the praises of Vulvan, Great Spirit of the Ring of Fires.

name: Warforged Retribution

name: Wolfblade Scythe
description: A scythe for a member of at proud and noble house of warriors. The house itself has since faded from memory but their warrior's pride lives in this curved blade.

name: Wolfhound's Pike
description: It is not only four-legged wolfhounds who have sharp fangs!

name: World's Core Spear (AC)
description: The origin of all magic, the cores of several worlds fused into one, have been condensed into a spear that can end time. This is a theoretical idea meant for a moment when there's nothing left to lose.

name: Wraith Warder

name: Wrath of Fire
description: Noted weaponsmith Schillie ventured deep in the heart of Firestorm and built this staff which contains an endless flame that represents the burning passion that the wielder possesses.

name: Wrath of the Dragon
description: Drakath hath no fury like a Dragon scorned! Storm headstrong into battle and unleash the might of an enraged dragon!
